## The model

<details markdown="1">
<summary>The same model, as math</summary>

The file states a plain `n.optimize()`, its multi-period class under the `multi_investment_periods` keyword, and its stochastic class, which `n.set_scenarios(...)` sets. Every quantity chosen once the future is known (second-stage) spans the futures dispatch is chosen in (`scenario`). Capacity is chosen once, before the future is known, and paid at its expected cost in each investment `period` its build year and lifetime span. Operation is the expectation over the scenarios' weights, with a share priced at the worst-outcome mean cost (CVaR) only where a risk preference is set. A plain run's data has one scenario, one period, unit weights, no outage and every `active` flag true, so the problem is the standard one. On a security-constrained run, PyPSA copies each branch flow limit once per `outage`, and the outage factors, `active` flags and scenario weights come from data prep.

#### Sets

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`\mathcal{B}`$ | index $`b`$ — `breakpoint` — the corners of a piecewise-linear curve, in order. A curve runs over the breakpoints its data has rows for, so curves may differ in length |
| $`\mathcal{N}`$ | index $`n`$ — `bus` with $`\mathrm{Generator\_bus}: \mathcal{G} \to \mathcal{N},\ \mathrm{Link\_bus0}: \mathcal{L} \to \mathcal{N},\ \mathrm{Link\_output\_bus}: \mathcal{O} \to \mathcal{N},\ \mathrm{Load\_bus}: \mathcal{D} \to \mathcal{N},\ \mathrm{Process\_output\_bus}: \mathcal{R} \to \mathcal{N},\ \mathrm{StorageUnit\_bus}: \mathcal{S} \to \mathcal{N},\ \mathrm{Store\_bus}: \mathcal{V} \to \mathcal{N}`$ — network nodes |
| $`\mathcal{G}`$ | index $`g`$ — `generator` with $`\mathrm{Generator\_bus}: \mathcal{G} \to \mathcal{N}`$ — generating units, each on one bus |
| $`\mathcal{L}`$ | index $`l`$ — `global_constraint` — PyPSA's `GlobalConstraint` rows, one label per declared limit |
| $`\mathcal{L}`$ | index $`l`$ — `link` with $`\mathrm{Link\_bus0}: \mathcal{L} \to \mathcal{N},\ \mathrm{Link\_output\_link}: \mathcal{O} \to \mathcal{L}`$ — controllable connections, each from one bus to the buses it delivers to |
| $`\mathcal{O}`$ | index $`o`$ — `link_output` with $`\mathrm{Link\_output\_bus}: \mathcal{O} \to \mathcal{N},\ \mathrm{Link\_output\_link}: \mathcal{O} \to \mathcal{L}`$ — a link's output ports, one label per port a link declares. The labels are PyPSA's `bus1`, `bus2`, … columns read long, data prep. A link of any number of output ports is then one term in the balance |
| $`\mathcal{D}`$ | index $`d`$ — `load` with $`\mathrm{Load\_bus}: \mathcal{D} \to \mathcal{N}`$ — demands, each on one bus |
| $`\mathcal{Y}`$ | index $`y`$ — `period` with $`\mathrm{snapshot\_period}: \mathcal{T} \to \mathcal{Y}`$ — investment periods. It is PyPSA's `investment_periods` |
| $`\mathcal{J}`$ | index $`j`$ — `process` with $`\mathrm{Process\_output\_process}: \mathcal{R} \to \mathcal{J}`$ — generalised multi-port converters, each with an internal power that every port draws or delivers at its own rate |
| $`\mathcal{R}`$ | index $`r`$ — `process_output` with $`\mathrm{Process\_output\_bus}: \mathcal{R} \to \mathcal{N},\ \mathrm{Process\_output\_process}: \mathcal{R} \to \mathcal{J}`$ — a process's ports, one label per port a process declares. The labels are PyPSA's `bus0`, `bus1`, …, each with a signed `rate`, data prep. A process of any number of ports is then one term in the balance |
| $`\Xi`$ | index $`\xi`$ — `scenario` — the futures dispatch is chosen in, each with a weight |
| $`\mathcal{T}`$ | index $`t`$ — `snapshot` with $`\mathrm{snapshot\_period}: \mathcal{T} \to \mathcal{Y}`$ — dispatch periods |
| $`\mathcal{S}`$ | index $`s`$ — `storage_unit` with $`\mathrm{StorageUnit\_bus}: \mathcal{S} \to \mathcal{N}`$ — storage units, dispatch and store behind one bus connection |
| $`\mathcal{V}`$ | index $`v`$ — `store` with $`\mathrm{Store\_bus}: \mathcal{V} \to \mathcal{N}`$ — pure energy stores, each on one bus |

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`\mathrm{Bus\_attached}`$ | `Bus_attached` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \mathcal{T}`$ — whether a load, a unit, a port or a branch that is active in the snapshot's period is attached to the bus, data prep. A bus nothing is attached to has no balance row |
| $`\mathrm{on}`$ | `Generator_active` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \mathcal{T}`$ — whether a generator is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, from build year and lifetime, data prep |

Where it does not, the energy still in transit at each period's first snapshots is lost. The flag is the same in every scenario, as the delay is |
| $`\mathrm{d}^{z}`$ | `Process_output_delay` over $`\mathcal{R}`$ — snapshots a port's transfer lags its process's internal power (PyPSA's `delay0`, `delay1`, … read long). In data prep you divide it by the `snapshot_weightings.generators` value and round it up. It is zero for a port that transfers at once. A port has the same delay in every scenario, as a link's port has |

It is negative where the port withdraws and positive where it injects. A link is a process whose `bus0` rate is minus one and whose output rates are its efficiencies. The rate at the snapshot the transfer arrives applies, so a delayed port transfers at its arrival snapshot's rate (`constraints.py:1575`) |
| $`\mathrm{on}^{h}`$ | `StorageUnit_active` over $`\mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — whether a storage unit is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data prep |

A unit that is active in no snapshot of the horizon still counts. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:54`) |
| $`\mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap},h}`$ | `StorageUnit_capital_cost` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{S}`$ — cost of one unit of nominal power for the modelled horizon (PyPSA's `periodized_cost`), data prep. | $`\mathrm{cyc}`$ | `StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{S}`$ — whether the horizon closes on itself instead of opening on the initial charge |

#### Conditions

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`\mathrm{Generator\_committed}`$ | `Generator_committed` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \mathcal{T}`$ — a committable generator that is active in the snapshot's period: every unit-commitment row's set |
| $`\mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}`$ | `Generator_marginal_cost_curve` over $`\mathcal{G}`$ — a generator that pays along a piecewise `marginal_cost` curve: one of PyPSA's `active_assets` with curve data (`optimize.py:307`, `piecewise.py:230-257`) |
| $`\mathrm{Generator\_ramps\_from\_previous}`$ | `Generator_ramps_from_previous` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — a snapshot whose ramp uses a previous output. It is any snapshot but its period's first, and the horizon's first where the generator comes in off or carries an initial output |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_committed}`$ | `Link_committed` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \mathcal{T}`$ — a committable link that is active in the snapshot's period: every unit-commitment row's set |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_ramps\_from\_previous}`$ | `Link_ramps_from_previous` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — a snapshot whose ramp uses a previous output. It is any snapshot but its period's first, and the horizon's first where the link comes in off or carries an initial output |
| $`\mathrm{StorageUnit\_ext}`$ | `StorageUnit_ext` over $`\mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — a storage unit with an extendable build that is active in the snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `ext` rows |
| $`\mathrm{StorageUnit\_fix}`$ | `StorageUnit_fix` over $`\mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — a storage unit with a fixed build that is active in the snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `fix` rows |

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`C^{\mathrm{curve}}`$ | `Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Generator-marginal_cost_piecewise` — the running cost of a generator that pays along a curve, held above the curve |

| $`P`$ | `Generator_p_nom_ext` over $`\mathcal{G}`$ — `Generator-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a generator that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name |
| $`u`$ | `Generator_status` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Generator-status` — how much of a committable unit is on. It is an integer the rows below cap at one, or at the module count where the build is modular |
| $`f`$ | `Link_p` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Link-p` — PyPSA's `p0`, the flow measured at the `Link_bus0` end. A positive value withdraws there and injects at every bus the link's output ports deliver to |
| $`F`$ | `Link_p_nom_ext` over $`\mathcal{L}`$ — `Link-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a link that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name |
| $`u^{f}`$ | `Link_status` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Link-status` — how much of a committable link is on. It is an integer the rows below cap at one, or at the module count where the build is modular |
| $`z`$ | `Process_p` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Process-p` — PyPSA's internal power `p`. A positive value drives every port at its own rate, withdrawing where the rate is negative and injecting where it is positive |
| $`h^{+}`$ | `StorageUnit_p_dispatch` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-p_dispatch` — power delivered to the bus |
| $`H`$ | `StorageUnit_p_nom_ext` over $`\mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a storage unit that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name |
| $`h^{-}`$ | `StorageUnit_p_store` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-p_store` — power drawn from the bus into charge |
| $`\mathit{soc}`$ | `StorageUnit_state_of_charge` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-state_of_charge` — energy held at the end of a snapshot |
| $`e`$ | `Store_e` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — `Store-e` — energy held at the end of a snapshot |
| $`E`$ | `Store_e_nom_ext` over $`\mathcal{V}`$ — `Store-e_nom` — nominal capacity where it is a decision, for a store that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name |

#### Definitions

| Symbol | Meaning |

| $`\mathit{Bus\_injection}`$ | `Bus_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_capex}`$ | `Generator_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_injection}`$ | `Generator_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_opex}`$ | `Generator_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_p\_carried\_over}`$ | `Generator_p_carried_over` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the output a generator carries over into a snapshot. At the first, it is the `p_init` it brought in, which is zero where it came in off. After that, it is the previous snapshot's |
| $`\mathrm{Generator\_p\_nom\_committed}`$ | `Generator_p_nom_committed` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi`$ — the build a committed unit's ramp rows are taken against: one module where the build is modular, since its status counts modules, and the given build otherwise (`constraints.py:1131-1134`) |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_p\_nom\_effective}`$ | `Generator_p_nom_effective` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi`$ — the build a generator's limits are taken against: the chosen one where it is extendable, the given one otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_previous\_p}`$ | `Generator_previous_p` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the output a generator carries into a snapshot. It is nothing at the first snapshot it is active in past the first of the horizon: PyPSA fills an output it did not build with zero (`constraints.py:716`). It is the output carried over otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_previous\_status}`$ | `Generator_previous_status` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the commitment state a generator carries into a snapshot. It is off at the first snapshot it is active in past the first of the horizon. PyPSA reads a status it did not build as off there (`constraints.py:391`). It is the state carried over otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_ramp\_down\_allowance}`$ | `Generator_ramp_down_allowance` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — how far a generator may lower output between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build while it stays on, plus its shut-down ramp in the snapshot it turns off |
| $`\mathrm{Generator\_ramp\_down\_rate}`$ | `Generator_ramp_down_rate` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the ramp limit in a unit's down row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_down`. It is the full build where PyPSA has none, since a shut-down ramp alone builds the row |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_ramp\_previous\_status}`$ | `Generator_ramp_previous_status` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the status a committed unit's ramp rows carry into a snapshot. At the first snapshot, a fixed modular unit that came in running has every module on, since the state it brought in is on or off (`constraints.py:1152-1157`). The transition and down-time rows count it as one module (PyPSA/PyPSA\#2114). It is the state carried in otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_ramp\_up\_allowance}`$ | `Generator_ramp_up_allowance` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — how far a generator may raise output between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build while it stays on, plus its start-up ramp in the snapshot it turns on |
| $`\mathrm{Generator\_ramp\_up\_rate}`$ | `Generator_ramp_up_rate` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the ramp limit in a unit's up row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_up`. It is the full build where PyPSA has none, since a start-up ramp alone builds the row |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}`$ | `Generator_running_cost` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a generator's output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`) |
| $`\mathrm{Generator\_shut\_down\_rate}`$ | `Generator_shut_down_rate` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi`$ — the shut-down ramp in a unit's down row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_shut_down`), or the full build where it has none |
| $`\mathrm{Generator\_start\_up\_rate}`$ | `Generator_start_up_rate` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi`$ — the start-up ramp in a unit's up row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_start_up`), or the full build where it has none |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_status\_carried\_over}`$ | `Generator_status_carried_over` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the state a generator carries over into a snapshot: the state it brought into the horizon at the first, the previous snapshot's after that |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}`$ | `Generator_tech_capacity_expansion` over $`\mathcal{L}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_capex}`$ | `Link_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{Link\_injection}`$ | `Link_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_opex}`$ | `Link_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Link_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{O} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathit{Link\_p\_carried\_over}`$ | `Link_p_carried_over` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the output a link carries over into a snapshot. At the first, it is the `p_init` it brought in, which is zero where it came in off. After that, it is the previous snapshot's |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}`$ | `Link_p_nom_committed` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — the build a committed link's ramp rows are taken against: one module where the build is modular, since its status counts modules, and the given build otherwise (`constraints.py:1131-1134`) |
| $`\mathit{Link\_p\_nom\_effective}`$ | `Link_p_nom_effective` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — the build a link's limits are taken against: the chosen one where it is extendable, the given one otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Link\_previous\_p}`$ | `Link_previous_p` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the output a link carries into a snapshot. It is nothing at the first snapshot it is active in past the first of the horizon: PyPSA fills an output it did not build with zero (`constraints.py:716`). It is the output carried over otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Link\_previous\_status}`$ | `Link_previous_status` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the commitment state a link carries into a snapshot. It is off at the first snapshot it is active in past the first of the horizon. PyPSA reads a status it did not build as off there (`constraints.py:391`). It is the state carried over otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Link\_ramp\_down\_allowance}`$ | `Link_ramp_down_allowance` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — how far a link may lower flow between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build while it stays on, plus its shut-down ramp in the snapshot it turns off |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_ramp\_down\_rate}`$ | `Link_ramp_down_rate` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the ramp limit in a link's down row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_down`. It is the full build where PyPSA has none, since a shut-down ramp alone builds the row |
| $`\mathit{Link\_ramp\_previous\_status}`$ | `Link_ramp_previous_status` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the status a committed link's ramp rows carry into a snapshot. At the first snapshot, a fixed modular link that came in running has every module on, since the state it brought in is on or off (`constraints.py:1152-1157`). The transition and down-time rows count it as one module (PyPSA/PyPSA\#2114). It is the state carried in otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Link\_ramp\_up\_allowance}`$ | `Link_ramp_up_allowance` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — how far a link may raise flow between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build while it stays on, plus its start-up ramp in the snapshot it turns on |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_ramp\_up\_rate}`$ | `Link_ramp_up_rate` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the ramp limit in a link's up row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_up`. It is the full build where PyPSA has none, since a start-up ramp alone builds the row |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_shut\_down\_rate}`$ | `Link_shut_down_rate` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — the shut-down ramp in a link's down row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_shut_down`), or the full build where it has none |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_start\_up\_rate}`$ | `Link_start_up_rate` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — the start-up ramp in a link's up row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_start_up`), or the full build where it has none |
| $`\mathit{Link\_status\_carried\_over}`$ | `Link_status_carried_over` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the state a link carries over into a snapshot: the state it brought into the horizon at the first, the previous snapshot's after that |
| $`\mathit{Link\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}`$ | `Link_tech_capacity_expansion` over $`\mathcal{L}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_transmission\_expansion\_cost}`$ | `Link_transmission_expansion_cost` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_transmission\_volume\_expansion}`$ | `Link_transmission_volume_expansion` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_demand}`$ | `Load_demand` over $`\mathcal{D} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`) |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_injection}`$ | `Load_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_injection}`$ | `Process_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Process_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{R} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_capex}`$ | `StorageUnit_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_charge\_carried\_in}`$ | `StorageUnit_charge_carried_in` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — the charge a unit opens a snapshot with. At the first snapshot it is active in, it is its last such snapshot's less standing loss where it is cyclic. Where it is not, it is the given initial charge, which no standing loss has touched yet. Otherwise it is the previous snapshot's less standing loss. A unit built in a later period opens in that period, and a cyclic one that retires closes on its own last snapshot. Per period, the same holds with each investment period as the horizon |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_injection}`$ | `StorageUnit_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_opex}`$ | `StorageUnit_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}`$ | `StorageUnit_tech_capacity_expansion` over $`\mathcal{L}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Store\_capex}`$ | `Store_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathrm{Store\_charge\_cap\_pu}`$ | `Store_charge_cap_pu` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — the most charging through `p_store`, per unit of `e_nom`. It is `-p_min_pu / max_hours` for a store that splits its dispatch, and zero otherwise (`stores.py:79-86`) |
| $`\mathit{Store\_energy\_carried\_in}`$ | `Store_energy_carried_in` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — the energy a store opens a snapshot with. At the first snapshot it is active in, it is its last such snapshot's less standing loss where it is cyclic. Where it is not, it is the given initial energy, which no standing loss has touched yet. Otherwise it is the previous snapshot's less standing loss. A store built in a later period opens in that period, and a cyclic one that retires closes on its own last snapshot. Per period, the same holds with each investment period as the horizon |
| $`\mathit{Store\_injection}`$ | `Store_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Store\_opex}`$ | `Store_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Store\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}`$ | `Store_tech_capacity_expansion` over $`\mathcal{L}`$ |
| $`\mathrm{energy\_limit\_weight}`$ | `energy_limit_weight` over $`\mathcal{T}`$ — what one unit of power at a snapshot counts for in an `e_sum` row: the generator weighting times the years of the snapshot's period, as in an `operational_limit` row (`constraints.py:2935-2937`) |
| $`\mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex}`$ | `risk_weighted_opex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{scenario\_opex}`$ | `scenario_opex` over $`\Xi`$ — what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot's hours and its period, before the scenario's own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted, as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`) |
| $`\mathit{tech\_capacity\_expansion}`$ | `tech_capacity_expansion` over $`\mathcal{L}`$ — what a `tech_capacity_expansion_limit` row totals: the chosen build of the row's carrier-and-bus set |
| $`\mathit{total\_cost}`$ | `total_cost` (scalar) — what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail |
| $`\mathit{transmission\_expansion\_cost}`$ | `transmission_expansion_cost` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — what a `transmission_expansion_cost_limit` row totals: capital cost times the chosen build of the row's branches |
| $`\mathit{transmission\_volume\_expansion}`$ | `transmission_volume_expansion` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — what a `transmission_volume_expansion_limit` row totals: length times the chosen build of the row's branches |

#### Notation

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`t \ominus k`$ | `edge='wrap'` — $`t-k`$, cyclic |
| $`t \boxminus_{v} k`$ | `edge=v` — $`t-k`$, and $`v`$ past the edge |
| $`t \ominus^{\mathrm{relation}(t)} k`$ | `within=relation[...]` — $`t-k`$ inside the group of $`t`$ |
| $`\mathrm{pos}(t)`$ | `position()` — the position of $`t`$, counted from $`0`$; $`t`$ is the label |
| $`\mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{relation}(t)}(t)`$ | `position(within=relation[...])` — the position of $`t`$ inside its group |

#### Conditions

**`Generator_committed`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_committed}_{g,t} \iff \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_marginal_cost_curve`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \iff \lvert \{ b \in \mathcal{B} \,:\, \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{curve}}_{b,g} \text{ is defined} \} \rvert > 0 \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G}
```

**`Generator_ramps_from_previous`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_ramps\_from\_previous}_{g,\xi,t} \iff \mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)}(t) > 0 \vee \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \wedge \left( \mathrm{u}^{0}_{g,\xi} = 0 \vee \mathrm{p}^{0}_{g,\xi} \text{ is defined} \right) \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_committed`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_committed}_{l,t} \iff \mathrm{com}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramps_from_previous`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_ramps\_from\_previous}_{l,\xi,t} \iff \mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)}(t) > 0 \vee \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \wedge \left( \mathrm{u}^{f,0}_{l,\xi} = 0 \vee \mathrm{f}^{0}_{l,\xi} \text{ is defined} \right) \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`StorageUnit_ext`**

```math
\mathrm{StorageUnit\_ext}_{t,s} \iff \mathrm{ext}^{h}_{s} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{h}_{t,s} \qquad \forall\, t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S}
```

**`StorageUnit_fix`**

```math
\mathrm{StorageUnit\_fix}_{t,s} \iff \neg \mathrm{ext}^{h}_{s} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{h}_{t,s} \qquad \forall\, t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S}
```

#### Variable domains

**`Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise`**

```math
C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_p`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_p_nom_ext`**

```math
P_{g} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g}
```

**`Generator_status`**

```math
u_{g,\xi,t} \ge 0, u_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{Z} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_committed}_{g,t}
```

**`Link_p`**

```math
f_{l,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t}
```

**`Link_p_nom_ext`**

```math
F_{l} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{act}^{f}_{l}
```

**`Link_status`**

```math
u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \ge 0, u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{Z} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_committed}_{l,t}
```

**`Process_p`**

```math
z_{j,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t}
```

**`StorageUnit_p_dispatch`**

```math
h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{h}_{t,s}
```

**`StorageUnit_p_nom_ext`**

```math
H_{s} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}^{h}_{s} \wedge \mathrm{act}^{h}_{s}
```

**`StorageUnit_p_store`**

```math
h^{-}_{\xi,t,s} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{h}_{t,s}
```

**`StorageUnit_state_of_charge`**

```math
\mathit{soc}_{\xi,t,s} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{h}_{t,s}
```

**`Store_e`**

```math
e_{\xi,t,v} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ v \in \mathcal{V} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{e}_{t,v}
```

**`Store_e_nom_ext`**

```math
E_{v} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, v \in \mathcal{V} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}^{e}_{v} \wedge \mathrm{act}^{e}_{v}
```

**`Store_p`**

```math
q_{\xi,t,v} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ v \in \mathcal{V} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{e}_{t,v}
```

**`Store_p_store`**

```math
q^{-}_{\xi,t,v} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ v \in \mathcal{V} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{e}_{t,v}
```

#### Definitions

**`Bus_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Bus\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Link\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Load\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Process\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{StorageUnit\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Store\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_capex`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_capex} = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot P_{g} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap}}_{g,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{W}_{g}
```

**`Generator_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_bus}(g) = n} \mathrm{sgn}_{g} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{(2)}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Generator_p_carried_over`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_p\_carried\_over}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{p}^{0}_{g,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \\ p_{g,\xi,t - 1} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_p_nom_committed`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_p\_nom\_committed}_{g,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{g} & \text{if } \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{g} > 0 \\ \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Generator_p_nom_effective`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_p\_nom\_effective}_{g,\xi} = \begin{cases} P_{g} & \text{if } \mathrm{ext}_{g} \\ \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Generator_previous_p`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_previous\_p}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} 0 & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) > 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{on}_{g,t - 1} \\ \mathit{Generator\_p\_carried\_over}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_previous_status`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_previous\_status}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} 0 & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) > 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{on}_{g,t - 1} \\ \mathit{Generator\_status\_carried\_over}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_ramp_down_allowance`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_ramp\_down\_allowance}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{Generator\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{Generator\_p\_nom\_committed}_{g,\xi} \cdot u_{g,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Generator\_shut\_down\_rate}_{g,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{Generator\_p\_nom\_committed}_{g,\xi} \cdot \left( \mathit{Generator\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{g,\xi,t} - u_{g,\xi,t} \right) & \text{if } \mathrm{com}_{g} \\ \mathrm{Generator\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathit{Generator\_p\_nom\_effective}_{g,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_ramp_down_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{rd}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{rd}_{g,\xi,t} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_ramp_previous_status`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{u}^{0}_{g,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{N}^{\mathrm{fix}}_{g,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{g} > 0 \\ \mathit{Generator\_previous\_status}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_ramp_up_allowance`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_ramp\_up\_allowance}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{Generator\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{Generator\_p\_nom\_committed}_{g,\xi} \cdot \mathit{Generator\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{g,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Generator\_start\_up\_rate}_{g,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{Generator\_p\_nom\_committed}_{g,\xi} \cdot \left( u_{g,\xi,t} - \mathit{Generator\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{g,\xi,t} \right) & \text{if } \mathrm{com}_{g} \\ \mathrm{Generator\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathit{Generator\_p\_nom\_effective}_{g,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_ramp_up_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{ru}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{ru}_{g,\xi,t} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_running_cost`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \\ p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_shut_down_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_shut\_down\_rate}_{g,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{rd}^{\mathrm{dn}}_{g,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{rd}^{\mathrm{dn}}_{g,\xi} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Generator_start_up_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_start\_up\_rate}_{g,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{ru}^{\mathrm{up}}_{g,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{ru}^{\mathrm{up}}_{g,\xi} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Generator_status_carried_over`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_status\_carried\_over}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{u}^{0}_{g,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \\ u_{g,\xi,t - 1} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_tech_capacity_expansion`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}_{l} = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} P_{g} \cdot \mathrm{m}_{g,l} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L}
```

**`Link_capex`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_capex} = \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot F_{l} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap},f}_{l,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{W}^{f}_{l}
```

**`Link_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = -\left( \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_bus0}(l) = n} f_{l,\xi,t} \right) + \sum_{o \in \mathcal{O} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_output\_bus}(o) = n} \mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}_{o,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f,(2)}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_output_arrival`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}_{o,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} f_{\mathrm{Link\_output\_link}(o),\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{f}} \cdot \eta_{o,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{f}_{o} \\ f_{\mathrm{Link\_output\_link}(o),\xi,t \boxminus_{0}^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{f}} \cdot \eta_{o,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, o \in \mathcal{O},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_p_carried_over`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_p\_carried\_over}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{f}^{0}_{l,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \\ f_{l,\xi,t - 1} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_p_nom_committed`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}_{l,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{l} & \text{if } \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{l} > 0 \\ \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{l,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_p_nom_effective`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_p\_nom\_effective}_{l,\xi} = \begin{cases} F_{l} & \text{if } \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \\ \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{l,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_previous_p`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_previous\_p}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} 0 & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) > 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t - 1} \\ \mathit{Link\_p\_carried\_over}_{l,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_previous_status`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} 0 & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) > 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t - 1} \\ \mathit{Link\_status\_carried\_over}_{l,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramp_down_allowance`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_ramp\_down\_allowance}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{Link\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}_{l,\xi} \cdot u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Link\_shut\_down\_rate}_{l,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}_{l,\xi} \cdot \left( \mathit{Link\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} - u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \right) & \text{if } \mathrm{com}^{f}_{l} \\ \mathrm{Link\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathit{Link\_p\_nom\_effective}_{l,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramp_down_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{rd}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{rd}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramp_previous_status`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{u}^{f,0}_{l,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{N}^{f,\mathrm{fix}}_{l,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{l} > 0 \\ \mathit{Link\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramp_up_allowance`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_ramp\_up\_allowance}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{Link\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}_{l,\xi} \cdot \mathit{Link\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Link\_start\_up\_rate}_{l,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}_{l,\xi} \cdot \left( u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} - \mathit{Link\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} \right) & \text{if } \mathrm{com}^{f}_{l} \\ \mathrm{Link\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathit{Link\_p\_nom\_effective}_{l,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramp_up_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{ru}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{ru}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_shut_down_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_shut\_down\_rate}_{l,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{rd}^{f,\mathrm{dn}}_{l,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{rd}^{f,\mathrm{dn}}_{l,\xi} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_start_up_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_start\_up\_rate}_{l,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{ru}^{f,\mathrm{up}}_{l,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{ru}^{f,\mathrm{up}}_{l,\xi} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_status_carried_over`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_status\_carried\_over}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{u}^{f,0}_{l,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \\ u^{f}_{l,\xi,t - 1} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_tech_capacity_expansion`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}_{l} = \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} F_{l} \cdot \mathrm{m}^{f}_{l,l} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L}
```

**`Link_transmission_expansion_cost`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_transmission\_expansion\_cost}_{l,\xi} = \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} F_{l} \cdot \mathrm{cc}^{f}_{l,l,\xi} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_transmission_volume_expansion`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_transmission\_volume\_expansion}_{l,\xi} = \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} F_{l} \cdot \mathrm{len}^{f}_{l,l,\xi} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Load_demand`**

```math
\mathrm{Load\_demand}_{d,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{sgn}^{\mathrm{load}}_{d} \cdot \mathrm{load}_{d,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{on}^{\mathrm{load}}_{d} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, d \in \mathcal{D},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Load_injection`**

```math
\mathrm{Load\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{d \in \mathcal{D} \,:\, \mathrm{Load\_bus}(d) = n} \mathrm{Load\_demand}_{d,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R} \,:\, \mathrm{Process\_output\_bus}(r) = n} \mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}_{r,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_output_arrival`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}_{r,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} z_{\mathrm{Process\_output\_process}(r),\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{z}} \cdot \alpha_{r,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{z}_{r} \\ z_{\mathrm{Process\_output\_process}(r),\xi,t \boxminus_{0}^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{z}} \cdot \alpha_{r,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, r \in \mathcal{R},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`StorageUnit_capex`**

```math
\mathit{StorageUnit\_capex} = \sum_{\xi \in \Xi,\ s \in \mathcal{S}} \pi_{\xi} \cdot H_{s} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap},h}_{\xi,s} \cdot \mathrm{W}^{h}_{s}
```

**`StorageUnit_charge_carried_in`**

```math
\mathit{StorageUnit\_charge\_carried\_in}_{\xi,t,s} = \begin{cases} \rho_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathit{soc}_{\xi,\left( t \ominus \mathrm{idle} \right) \ominus 1,s} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}_{\xi,s} \wedge \neg \mathrm{cyc}^{y}_{\xi,s} \wedge \neg \mathrm{reset}_{\xi,s} \wedge \left( \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \vee \mathrm{open}_{t,s} \right) \\ \mathrm{soc}^{0}_{\xi,s} & \text{if } \neg \mathrm{cyc}_{\xi,s} \wedge \neg \mathrm{cyc}^{y}_{\xi,s} \wedge \neg \mathrm{reset}_{\xi,s} \wedge \left( \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \vee \mathrm{open}_{t,s} \right) \\ \rho_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathit{soc}_{\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} 1,s} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{y}_{\xi,s} \\ \mathrm{soc}^{0}_{\xi,s} & \text{if } \mathrm{reset}_{\xi,s} \wedge \neg \mathrm{cyc}^{y}_{\xi,s} \wedge \mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)}(t) = 0 \\ \rho_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathit{soc}_{\xi,t - 1,s} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S}
```

**`StorageUnit_injection`**

```math
\mathit{StorageUnit\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{StorageUnit\_bus}(s) = n} \mathrm{sgn}^{h}_{s} \cdot \left( h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} - h^{-}_{\xi,t,s} \right) \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`StorageUnit_opex`**

```math
\mathit{StorageUnit\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{h}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{h,(2)}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} \mathit{soc}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{soc}}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`StorageUnit_tech_capacity_expansion`**

```math
\mathit{StorageUnit\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}_{l} = \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} H_{s} \cdot \mathrm{m}^{h}_{l,s} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L}
```

**`Store_capex`**

```math
\mathit{Store\_capex} = \sum_{\xi \in \Xi,\ v \in \mathcal{V}} \pi_{\xi} \cdot E_{v} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap},e}_{\xi,v} \cdot \mathrm{W}^{e}_{v}
```

**`Store_charge_cap_pu`**

```math
\mathrm{Store\_charge\_cap\_pu}_{\xi,t,v} = \begin{cases} \frac{-\underline{\mathrm{q}}_{\xi,t,v}}{\mathrm{T}^{e}_{\xi,v}} & \text{if } \mathrm{split}^{e}_{\xi,v} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ v \in \mathcal{V}
```

**`Store_energy_carried_in`**

```math
\mathit{Store\_energy\_carried\_in}_{\xi,t,v} = \begin{cases} \rho^{e}_{\xi,t,v} \cdot e_{\xi,\left( t \ominus \mathrm{idle}^{e} \right) \ominus 1,v} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{e}_{\xi,v} \wedge \neg \mathrm{cyc}^{e,y}_{\xi,v} \wedge \neg \mathrm{reset}^{e}_{\xi,v} \wedge \left( \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \vee \mathrm{open}^{e}_{t,v} \right) \\ \mathrm{e}^{0}_{\xi,v} & \text{if } \neg \mathrm{cyc}^{e}_{\xi,v} \wedge \neg \mathrm{cyc}^{e,y}_{\xi,v} \wedge \neg \mathrm{reset}^{e}_{\xi,v} \wedge \left( \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \vee \mathrm{open}^{e}_{t,v} \right) \\ \rho^{e}_{\xi,t,v} \cdot e_{\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} 1,v} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{e,y}_{\xi,v} \\ \mathrm{e}^{0}_{\xi,v} & \text{if } \mathrm{reset}^{e}_{\xi,v} \wedge \neg \mathrm{cyc}^{e,y}_{\xi,v} \wedge \mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)}(t) = 0 \\ \rho^{e}_{\xi,t,v} \cdot e_{\xi,t - 1,v} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ v \in \mathcal{V}
```

**`Store_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Store\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{v \in \mathcal{V} \,:\, \mathrm{Store\_bus}(v) = n} \mathrm{sgn}^{q}_{v} \cdot q_{\xi,t,v} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Store_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Store\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{v \in \mathcal{V}} q_{\xi,t,v} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{q}_{\xi,t,v} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{v \in \mathcal{V}} q_{\xi,t,v} \cdot q_{\xi,t,v} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{q,(2)}_{\xi,t,v} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{v \in \mathcal{V}} e_{\xi,t,v} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{e}_{\xi,t,v} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{v \in \mathcal{V}} \left( q_{\xi,t,v} + q^{-}_{\xi,t,v} \right) \cdot \mathrm{c}^{q,+}_{\xi,t,v} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{v \in \mathcal{V}} q^{-}_{\xi,t,v} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{q,-}_{\xi,t,v} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Store_tech_capacity_expansion`**

```math
\mathit{Store\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}_{l} = \sum_{v \in \mathcal{V}} E_{v} \cdot \mathrm{m}^{e}_{l,v} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L}
```

**`energy_limit_weight`**

```math
\mathrm{energy\_limit\_weight}_{t} = \mathrm{w}^{\mathrm{gen}}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{\mathrm{yr}}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`risk_weighted_opex`**

```math
\mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex} = \sum_{\xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot \mathit{scenario\_opex}_{\xi}
```

**`scenario_opex`**

```math
\mathit{scenario\_opex}_{\xi} = \mathit{Generator\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{Link\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{StorageUnit\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{Store\_opex}_{\xi} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`tech_capacity_expansion`**

```math
\mathit{tech\_capacity\_expansion}_{l} = \mathit{Generator\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}_{l} + \mathit{Link\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}_{l} + \mathit{StorageUnit\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}_{l} + \mathit{Store\_tech\_capacity\_expansion}_{l} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L}
```

**`total_cost`**

```math
\mathit{total\_cost} = \mathit{Generator\_capex} + \mathit{Link\_capex} + \mathit{StorageUnit\_capex} + \mathit{Store\_capex} + \mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex}
```

**`transmission_expansion_cost`**

```math
\mathit{transmission\_expansion\_cost}_{l,\xi} = \mathit{Link\_transmission\_expansion\_cost}_{l,\xi} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`transmission_volume_expansion`**

```math
\mathit{transmission\_volume\_expansion}_{l,\xi} = \mathit{Link\_transmission\_volume\_expansion}_{l,\xi} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

#### Objective

```math
\min \mathit{total\_cost}
```

#### Subject to

**`Bus_nodal_balance`**

```math
\mathit{Bus\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = 0 \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Bus\_attached}_{n,t}
```

**`Generator_e_sum_max`**

```math
\sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{energy\_limit\_weight}_{t} \le \overline{\mathrm{E}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi \,:\, \overline{\mathrm{E}}_{g,\xi} \text{ is defined} \wedge \lvert \{ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}_{g,t} \} \rvert > 0
```

**`Generator_e_sum_min`**

```math
\sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{energy\_limit\_weight}_{t} \ge \underline{\mathrm{E}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi \,:\, \underline{\mathrm{E}}_{g,\xi} \text{ is defined} \wedge \lvert \{ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}_{g,t} \} \rvert > 0
```

**`Generator_ext_p_lower`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \ge \underline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot P_{g} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_ext_p_nom_lower`**

```math
P_{g} \ge \underline{\mathrm{p}}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi \,:\, \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g}
```

**`Generator_ext_p_nom_upper`**

```math
P_{g} \le \overline{\mathrm{p}}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi \,:\, \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g} \wedge \overline{\mathrm{p}}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \text{ is defined}
```

**`Generator_ext_p_upper`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \le \overline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot P_{g} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_fix_p_lower`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \ge \underline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_fix_p_upper`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \le \overline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_p_nom_set`**

```math
P_{g} = \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom,set}}_{g} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom,set}}_{g} \text{ is defined}
```

**`Generator_p_ramp_limit_down`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_previous\_p}_{g,\xi,t} - p_{g,\xi,t} \le \mathit{Generator\_ramp\_down\_allowance}_{g,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \left( \mathrm{rd}_{g,\xi,t} \text{ is defined} \vee \mathrm{rd}^{\mathrm{dn}}_{g,\xi} \text{ is defined} \right) \wedge \neg \left( \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \left( \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{g} > 0 \right) \right) \wedge \mathrm{Generator\_ramps\_from\_previous}_{g,\xi,t} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_p_ramp_limit_up`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} - \mathit{Generator\_previous\_p}_{g,\xi,t} \le \mathit{Generator\_ramp\_up\_allowance}_{g,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \left( \mathrm{ru}_{g,\xi,t} \text{ is defined} \vee \mathrm{ru}^{\mathrm{up}}_{g,\xi} \text{ is defined} \right) \wedge \neg \left( \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \left( \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{g} > 0 \right) \right) \wedge \mathrm{Generator\_ramps\_from\_previous}_{g,\xi,t} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`GlobalConstraint_tech_capacity_expansion_limit_eq`**

```math
\mathit{tech\_capacity\_expansion}_{l} = \mathrm{K}_{l,\xi} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi \,:\, \mathrm{type}_{l} = \text{'}\mathrm{tech\_capacity\_expansion\_limit}\text{'} \wedge \mathrm{sense}_{l,\xi} = \text{'}\mathrm{==}\text{'}
```

**`GlobalConstraint_tech_capacity_expansion_limit_lb`**

```math
\mathit{tech\_capacity\_expansion}_{l} \ge \mathrm{K}_{l,\xi} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi \,:\, \mathrm{type}_{l} = \text{'}\mathrm{tech\_capacity\_expansion\_limit}\text{'} \wedge \mathrm{sense}_{l,\xi} = \text{'}\mathrm{>=}\text{'}
```

**`GlobalConstraint_tech_capacity_expansion_limit_ub`**


=== "specsolve"

    The spec, `differential/pypsa/rungs/rung_03_expansion.yaml` — the file projected onto what this rung builds:

    ```yaml
    version: 0
    description: The file states a plain `n.optimize()`, its multi-period class under the `multi_investment_periods`
      keyword, and its stochastic class, which `n.set_scenarios(...)` sets. Every quantity chosen once the
      future is known (second-stage) spans the futures dispatch is chosen in (`scenario`). Capacity is chosen
      once, before the future is known, and paid at its expected cost in each investment `period` its build
      year and lifetime span. Operation is the expectation over the scenarios' weights, with a share priced
      at the worst-outcome mean cost (CVaR) only where a risk preference is set. A plain run's data has one
      scenario, one period, unit weights, no outage and every `active` flag true, so the problem is the standard
      one. On a security-constrained run, PyPSA copies each branch flow limit once per `outage`, and the outage
      factors, `active` flags and scenario weights come from data prep.
    dimensions:
      breakpoint: {dtype: int, ordered: true, description: 'the corners of a piecewise-linear curve, in order.
          A curve runs over the breakpoints its data has rows for, so curves may differ in length'}
      bus: {description: network nodes}
      generator: {description: 'generating units, each on one bus'}
      global_constraint: {description: 'PyPSA''s `GlobalConstraint` rows, one label per declared limit'}
      link: {description: 'controllable connections, each from one bus to the buses it delivers to'}
      link_output: {description: 'a link''s output ports, one label per port a link declares. The labels are
          PyPSA''s `bus1`, `bus2`, … columns read long, data prep. A link of any number of output ports is
          then one term in the balance'}
      load: {description: 'demands, each on one bus'}
      period: {dtype: int, ordered: true, description: investment periods. It is PyPSA's `investment_periods`}
      process: {description: 'generalised multi-port converters, each with an internal power that every port
          draws or delivers at its own rate'}
      process_output: {description: 'a process''s ports, one label per port a process declares. The labels
          are PyPSA''s `bus0`, `bus1`, …, each with a signed `rate`, data prep. A process of any number of
          ports is then one term in the balance'}
      scenario: {description: 'the futures dispatch is chosen in, each with a weight'}
      snapshot: {dtype: datetime, ordered: true, description: dispatch periods}
      storage_unit: {description: 'storage units, dispatch and store behind one bus connection'}
      store: {description: 'pure energy stores, each on one bus'}
    relations:
      Generator_bus: {key: generator, values: bus, description: the bus a generator sits on}
      Link_bus0: {key: link, values: bus, description: the bus a link leaves}
      Link_output_bus: {key: link_output, values: bus, description: 'the bus an output port delivers to. It
          is PyPSA''s `bus1`, `bus2`, … columns. A link of three output ports is three labels here rather
          than a third relation, so the file states any number of them'}
      Link_output_link: {key: link_output, values: link, description: the link an output port belongs to}
      Load_bus: {key: load, values: bus, description: the bus a load sits on}
      Process_output_bus: {key: process_output, values: bus, description: 'the bus a port draws from or delivers
          to. It is PyPSA''s `bus0`, `bus1`, … columns. A process of three ports is three labels here rather
          than a third relation, so the file states any number of them'}
      Process_output_process: {key: process_output, values: process, description: the process a port belongs
          to}
      StorageUnit_bus: {key: storage_unit, values: bus, description: the bus a storage unit sits on}
      Store_bus: {key: store, values: bus, description: the bus a store sits on}
      snapshot_period: {key: snapshot, values: period, description: the investment period a snapshot falls
          in}
    parameters:
      Bus_attached:
        dims: [bus, snapshot]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a load, a unit, a port or a branch that is active in the snapshot's period is
          attached to the bus, data prep. A bus nothing is attached to has no balance row
      Generator_active:
        dims: [generator, snapshot]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a generator is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, from build
          year and lifetime, data prep
      Generator_active_asset:
        dims: [generator]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a generator is one of PyPSA's `active_assets`, by its `active` flag alone, without
          build year and lifetime. A unit that is active in no snapshot of the horizon still counts. PyPSA
          refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:54`)
      Generator_capital_cost:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        description: cost of one unit of nominal power for the modelled horizon (PyPSA's `periodized_cost`),
          data prep. It is `overnight_cost` as an annuity over `lifetime` at `discount_rate`, times `nyears`,
          where `overnight_cost` is given, and `capital_cost` where it is not. Both add `fom_cost` (`components.py:1157-1178`,
          `costs.py:102-203`)
      Generator_capital_weight:
        dims: [generator]
        description: the sum of period weights a generator is active in. It is PyPSA's `active * period_weighting`,
          summed, data prep
      Generator_committable:
        dims: [generator]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether output is gated by an on/off status decision

        dims: [generator, scenario]
        description: 'most energy over the horizon: a fuel or emission budget in energy terms. It is infinity

      Generator_e_sum_min:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        description: least energy over the horizon. It is minus infinity where no floor is meant

        description: 'the output at each breakpoint of a generator''s piecewise `marginal_cost` curve: PyPSA''s
          `p_pu` breakpoints times `p_nom`, data prep. A generator with no curve has no rows'
      Generator_marginal_cost_quadratic:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of the square of one unit of output
      Generator_modules_installed:
        dims: [generator, scenario]

      Generator_p_init:

        dims: [generator, scenario]
        description: least nominal power an extendable generator may be built at

      Generator_ramp_limit_down:

      Generator_ramp_limit_shut_down:

      Generator_ramp_limit_start_up:
        dims: [generator, scenario]

      Generator_ramp_limit_up:

      Generator_sign:
        dims: [generator]
        description: the sign output enters its bus's balance with. It is PyPSA's `sign`, `1` unless given,
          `-1` for a unit that draws power. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:46`)
      Generator_status_initial:

        description: one where the unit was on before the first snapshot, zero where off. It is PyPSA's `up_time_before

      GlobalConstraint_constant:

        description: whether a link is one of PyPSA's `active_assets`, by its `active` flag alone, without
          build year and lifetime. A unit that is active in no snapshot of the horizon still counts. PyPSA
          refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:54`)
      Link_capital_cost:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: cost of one unit of nominal power for the modelled horizon (PyPSA's `periodized_cost`),
          data prep. It is `overnight_cost` as an annuity over `lifetime` at `discount_rate`, times `nyears`,
          where `overnight_cost` is given, and `capital_cost` where it is not. Both add `fom_cost` (`components.py:1157-1178`,
          `costs.py:102-203`)
      Link_capital_weight:
        dims: [link]
        description: the sum of period weights a link is active in. It is PyPSA's `active * period_weighting`,
          summed, data prep
      Link_committable:
        dims: [link]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether flow is gated by an on/off status decision
      Link_efficiency:
        dims: [link_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'share of the flow that arrives at an output port, PyPSA''s `efficiency`, `efficiency2`,
          … read long: negative where that port consumes rather than delivers. Read at the snapshot the flow
          arrives, so a delayed port delivers at its arrival snapshot''s efficiency (`constraints.py:1575`)'
      Link_expansion_cost_weight:
        dims: [global_constraint, link, scenario]
        missing: absent
        description: the link's capital cost where its carrier is in the row's set, data prep. Where the row
          states no `investment_period` under `multi_investment_periods`, it is times the objective weights
          of the periods the link is active in. A link outside the set, or one that is not active in the row's
          period, has no row. The capital cost is PyPSA's `capital_cost` property, which is `Link_capital_cost`
          without `fom_cost` (`components.py:1182-1200`, `global_constraints.py:905-914`)
      Link_marginal_cost:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of one unit of flow
      Link_marginal_cost_quadratic:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of the square of one unit of flow
      Link_modules_installed:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: how many whole modules a committable build has in place, data prep. It is `Link_p_nom
          / Link_p_nom_mod` where a fixed build is modular, and one where it is not. PyPSA refuses a fixed
          modular build whose nominal power is not a whole number of modules
      Link_output_cyclic_delay:
        dims: [link_output]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a delayed port's flow wraps from the end of its investment period (PyPSA's `cyclic_delay`,
          `cyclic_delay2`, …). Where it does not, the flow still in transit at each period's first snapshots
          is lost. The flag is the same in every scenario, as the delay is
      Link_output_delay:
        dims: [link_output]
        dtype: int
        description: snapshots a port's delivery lags its link's flow (PyPSA's `delay`, `delay2`, … read long).
          In data prep you divide it by the `snapshot_weightings.generators` value and round it up. It is
          zero for a port that delivers at once. A port has the same delay in every scenario, because PyPSA
          refuses a delay that differs by scenario (`constants.py:55`)
      Link_p_init:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        missing: 0.0
        description: the flow a link brought into the horizon, data prep. It is PyPSA's `p_init` where the
          link came in running, and zero where it came in off. Under a rolling horizon, it is the flow the
          previous window solved. No value means it is unknown, and the link then has no ramp row at the first
          snapshot
      Link_p_max_pu:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: most flow, per unit of nominal power
      Link_p_min_pu:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'least flow, per unit of nominal power: negative for a link that carries both ways'
      Link_p_nom:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: nominal power
      Link_p_nom_extendable:
        dims: [link]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the nominal power is a decision
      Link_p_nom_max:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: most nominal power an extendable link may be built at
      Link_p_nom_min:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: least nominal power an extendable link may be built at
      Link_p_nom_mod:
        dims: [link]
        missing: absent
        description: the module size a build comes in whole numbers of. No value means the build is continuous
      Link_p_nom_set:
        dims: [link]
        missing: absent
        description: a given nominal power for an extendable link. One without a value has no row here
      Link_ramp_limit_down:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        missing: absent
        description: most a link may lower its flow between snapshots, per unit of nominal power. No value
          means no limit. The value at the later of the two snapshots applies, so the limit may change over
          time
      Link_ramp_limit_shut_down:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        missing: absent
        description: most flow in the snapshot before a link stops, per unit of nominal power. No value means
          no limit
      Link_ramp_limit_start_up:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        missing: absent
        description: most flow in the snapshot a link starts, per unit of nominal power. No value means no
          limit
      Link_ramp_limit_up:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        missing: absent
        description: most a link may raise its flow between snapshots, per unit of nominal power. No value
          means no limit. The value at the later of the two snapshots applies, so the limit may change over
          time
      Link_status_initial:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: one where the link was on before the first snapshot, zero where off. It is PyPSA's `up_time_before
          > 0` for a committable link, and one for a link that is not, whose ramp rows PyPSA starts from on
          (`constraints.py:323`), data prep. Under a rolling horizon, it is the status the previous window
          solved, a fraction where unit commitment is linearised
      Link_tech_capacity_weight:
        dims: [global_constraint, link]
        missing: absent
        description: one where the link is in the row's carrier-and-bus set, data prep. One outside it, or
          one that is not active in the row's `investment_period`, has no row
      Link_volume_weight:
        dims: [global_constraint, link, scenario]
        missing: absent
        description: the link's length in each scenario where its carrier is in the row's set (`global_constraints.py:882-883`),
          data prep. A link outside it, or one that is not active in the row's `investment_period`, has no
          row
      Load_active:
        dims: [load]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a load is active in the network, PyPSA's `active`. A load has no build year and
          no lifetime, so the flag is the same in every snapshot. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario
          (`constants.py:54`)
      Load_p_set:
        dims: [load, scenario, snapshot]
        description: demand
      Load_sign:
        dims: [load]
        description: the sign a load's demand enters its bus's balance with. It is PyPSA's `sign`, `-1` unless
          given, `1` for a load that feeds its bus. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:46`)
      Process_active:
        dims: [process, snapshot]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a process is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data prep
      Process_output_cyclic_delay:
        dims: [process_output]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a delayed port's transfer wraps from the end of its investment period (PyPSA's
          `cyclic_delay0`, `cyclic_delay1`, …). Where it does not, the energy still in transit at each period's
          first snapshots is lost. The flag is the same in every scenario, as the delay is
      Process_output_delay:
        dims: [process_output]
        dtype: int
        description: snapshots a port's transfer lags its process's internal power (PyPSA's `delay0`, `delay1`,
          … read long). In data prep you divide it by the `snapshot_weightings.generators` value and round
          it up. It is zero for a port that transfers at once. A port has the same delay in every scenario,
          as a link's port has
      Process_rate:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the energy a port draws or delivers per unit of internal power (PyPSA's `rate0`, `rate1`,
          … read long). It is negative where the port withdraws and positive where it injects. A link is a
          process whose `bus0` rate is minus one and whose output rates are its efficiencies. The rate at
          the snapshot the transfer arrives applies, so a delayed port transfers at its arrival snapshot's
          rate (`constraints.py:1575`)
      StorageUnit_active:
        dims: [snapshot, storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a storage unit is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data
          prep
      StorageUnit_active_asset:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a storage unit is one of PyPSA's `active_assets`, by its `active` flag alone,
          without build year and lifetime. A unit that is active in no snapshot of the horizon still counts.
          PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:54`)
      StorageUnit_capital_cost:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        description: cost of one unit of nominal power for the modelled horizon (PyPSA's `periodized_cost`),
          data prep. It is `overnight_cost` as an annuity over `lifetime` at `discount_rate`, times `nyears`,
          where `overnight_cost` is given, and `capital_cost` where it is not. Both add `fom_cost` (`components.py:1157-1178`,
          `costs.py:102-203`)
      StorageUnit_capital_weight:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        description: the sum of period weights a storage unit is active in. It is PyPSA's `active * period_weighting`,
          summed, data prep
      StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the horizon closes on itself instead of opening on the initial charge
      StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether each investment period closes on itself instead of carrying its charge on to
          the next. It overrides `cyclic_state_of_charge` and `state_of_charge_initial_per_period`. PyPSA
          reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed false in data prep
      StorageUnit_efficiency_dispatch:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: share of the charge drawn down that reaches the bus
      StorageUnit_efficiency_store:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: share of the power drawn from the bus that becomes charge
      StorageUnit_inactive_snapshots:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        dtype: int
        description: how many snapshots a storage unit is not active in. It is PyPSA's `(~active).sum()`,
          data prep. A cyclic unit reaches back this many snapshots further, so it closes on the last snapshot
          it is active in
      StorageUnit_inflow:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: energy arriving per hour, a river into a reservoir
      StorageUnit_marginal_cost:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: cost of one unit of dispatch
      StorageUnit_marginal_cost_quadratic:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: cost of the square of one unit of dispatch. Storing is not charged
      StorageUnit_marginal_cost_storage:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: cost of one unit of charge held over one snapshot
      StorageUnit_max_hours:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        description: energy capacity, as hours of dispatch at nominal power
      StorageUnit_opens_late:
        dims: [snapshot, storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a snapshot is the first a storage unit is active in, where that is not the first
          of the horizon, data prep. It is PyPSA's `active.cumsum() == 1` over the snapshots it is active
          in, past the first snapshot. It is false in a run where every unit is active throughout
      StorageUnit_p_max_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: most dispatch, per unit of nominal power
      StorageUnit_p_min_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: most storing, per unit of nominal power and negated
      StorageUnit_p_nom:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        description: nominal power
      StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the nominal power is a decision
      StorageUnit_p_nom_max:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        description: most nominal power an extendable storage unit may be built at
      StorageUnit_p_nom_min:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        description: least nominal power an extendable storage unit may be built at
      StorageUnit_p_nom_set:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        missing: absent
        description: a given nominal power for an extendable storage unit. One without a value has no row
          here
      StorageUnit_retention:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: share of charge kept over a snapshot. It is PyPSA's `(1 - standing_loss) ** elapsed hours`,
          data prep
      StorageUnit_sign:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        description: the sign net dispatch enters its bus's balance with. It is PyPSA's `sign`, `1` unless
          given. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:46`)
      StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        description: charge held before the first snapshot
      StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial_per_period:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether each investment period opens on the initial charge instead of carrying the previous
          period's. PyPSA reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed false in data
          prep
      StorageUnit_tech_capacity_weight:
        dims: [global_constraint, storage_unit]
        missing: absent
        description: one where the storage unit is in the row's carrier-and-bus set, data prep. One outside
          it, or one that is not active in the row's `investment_period`, has no row
      Store_active:
        dims: [snapshot, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a store is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data prep
      Store_active_asset:
        dims: [store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a store is one of PyPSA's `active_assets`, by its `active` flag alone, without
          build year and lifetime. A unit that is active in no snapshot of the horizon still counts. PyPSA
          refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:54`)
      Store_capital_cost:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        description: cost of one unit of nominal capacity for the modelled horizon (PyPSA's `periodized_cost`),
          data prep. It is `overnight_cost` as an annuity over `lifetime` at `discount_rate`, times `nyears`,
          where `overnight_cost` is given, and `capital_cost` where it is not. Both add `fom_cost` (`components.py:1157-1178`,
          `costs.py:102-203`)
      Store_capital_weight:
        dims: [store]
        description: the sum of period weights a store is active in. It is PyPSA's `active * period_weighting`,
          summed, data prep
      Store_e_cyclic:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the horizon closes on itself instead of opening on the initial energy
      Store_e_cyclic_per_period:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether each investment period closes on itself instead of carrying its energy on to
          the next. It overrides `e_cyclic` and `e_initial_per_period`. PyPSA reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`.
          Otherwise you feed false in data prep
      Store_e_initial:
        dims: [scenario, store]
    ```
