    ```yaml
        description: energy held before the first snapshot
      Store_e_initial_per_period:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether each investment period opens on the initial energy instead of carrying the previous
          period's. PyPSA reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed false in data
          prep
      Store_e_max_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: most energy held, per unit of nominal capacity
      Store_e_min_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: 'least energy held, per unit of nominal capacity: negative for a store that may go short'
      Store_e_nom:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        description: nominal energy capacity
      Store_e_nom_extendable:
        dims: [store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the nominal energy capacity is a decision
      Store_e_nom_max:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        description: most nominal capacity an extendable store may be built at
      Store_e_nom_min:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        description: least nominal capacity an extendable store may be built at
      Store_e_nom_set:
        dims: [store]
        missing: absent
        description: a given nominal capacity for an extendable store. One without a value has no row here
      Store_efficiency_dispatch:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: share of the energy drawn down that reaches the bus
      Store_efficiency_store:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: share of the power drawn from the bus that becomes energy held
      Store_inactive_snapshots:
        dims: [store]
        dtype: int
        description: how many snapshots a store is not active in. It is PyPSA's `(~active).sum()`, data prep.
          A cyclic store reaches back this many snapshots further, so it closes on the last snapshot it is
          active in
      Store_inflow:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: energy arriving per hour, a river into a reservoir
      Store_marginal_cost:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: cost of one unit of power delivered
      Store_marginal_cost_dispatch:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: cost of one unit of discharge, `p + p_store`
      Store_marginal_cost_quadratic:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: cost of the square of the net power delivered, so charging costs as much as delivering
      Store_marginal_cost_storage:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: cost of one unit of energy held over one snapshot
      Store_marginal_cost_store:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: cost of one unit of charging, `p_store`
      Store_max_hours:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        missing: absent
        description: energy capacity, as hours of discharge at the power rating. The rating is `e_nom / max_hours`.
          No value means PyPSA's default of infinity, and the store's power is then unbounded
      Store_opens_late:
        dims: [snapshot, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a snapshot is the first a store is active in, where that is not the first of
          the horizon, data prep. It is PyPSA's `active.cumsum() == 1` over the snapshots it is active in,
          past the first snapshot. It is false in a run where every store is active throughout
      Store_p_min_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: most charging, per unit of the power rating, negated. It is PyPSA's `p_min_pu`, `-1`
          unless given, read only where `max_hours` has a value
      Store_retention:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: share of energy kept over a snapshot. It is PyPSA's `(1 - standing_loss) ** elapsed hours`,
          data prep
      Store_sign:
        dims: [store]
        description: the sign the power a store delivers enters its bus's balance with. It is PyPSA's `sign`,
          `1` unless given. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:46`)
      Store_split_dispatch:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: 'whether a store charges through `p_store` apart from its net dispatch `p`. It is PyPSA''s
          `split_dispatch()`: true where an efficiency differs from one, a cost applies to one direction only,
          or `cycles_max` is finite, in any snapshot (`stores.py:88-116`), data prep. Where it is false, `p_store`
          is held at zero and the charging bound applies to `p`'
      Store_tech_capacity_weight:
        dims: [global_constraint, store]
        missing: absent
        description: one where the store is in the row's carrier-and-bus set, data prep. One outside it, or
          one that is not active in the row's `investment_period`, has no row
      period_weight_objective:
        dims: [period]
        description: PyPSA's `investment_period_weightings.objective` — what a period's cost weighs. PyPSA
          reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed one in data prep, whatever the
          column contains (`optimize.py:231-233`, `:293-297`)
      period_weight_years:
        dims: [period]
        description: PyPSA's `investment_period_weightings.years` — what a period's energy weighs in a `primary_energy`,
          `operational_limit` or `e_sum` row. PyPSA reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise
          you feed one in data prep
      scenario_weight:
        dims: [scenario]
        description: PyPSA's `scenario_weightings.weight` — the probability of a future
      snapshot_weightings_generators:
        dims: [snapshot]
        description: PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.generators` — hours a snapshot weighs in an energy total
      snapshot_weightings_objective:
        dims: [snapshot]
        description: PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.objective` — hours a snapshot weighs in the cost
      snapshot_weightings_stores:
        dims: [snapshot]
        description: PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.stores` — hours a snapshot weighs in a storage balance
    variables:
      Generator_p:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-p` — output of a generator in a snapshot'
      Generator_p_nom_ext:
        dims: [generator]
        where: Generator_p_nom_extendable AND Generator_active_asset
        description: '`Generator-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a generator that is active.
          A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      Link_p:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_active
        description: '`Link-p` — PyPSA''s `p0`, the flow measured at the `Link_bus0` end. A positive value
          withdraws there and injects at every bus the link''s output ports deliver to'
      Link_p_nom_ext:
        dims: [link]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_active_asset
        description: '`Link-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a link that is active. A fixed
          build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      StorageUnit_p_dispatch:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        description: '`StorageUnit-p_dispatch` — power delivered to the bus'
      StorageUnit_p_nom_ext:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_active_asset
        description: '`StorageUnit-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a storage unit that
          is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      StorageUnit_p_store:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        description: '`StorageUnit-p_store` — power drawn from the bus into charge'
      StorageUnit_state_of_charge:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        description: '`StorageUnit-state_of_charge` — energy held at the end of a snapshot'
      Store_e:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_active
        description: '`Store-e` — energy held at the end of a snapshot'
      Store_e_nom_ext:
        dims: [store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active_asset
        description: '`Store-e_nom` — nominal capacity where it is a decision, for a store that is active.
          A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      Store_p:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_active
        description: '`Store-p` — net power delivered to the bus. Charging is negative'
      Store_p_store:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_active
        description: '`Store-p_store` — power drawn from the bus to charge, so that `p + p_store` is the discharge.
          It is held at zero by its rows where the store does not split its dispatch'
      Generator_status:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_committed
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Generator-status` — how much of a committable unit is on. It is an integer the rows
          below cap at one, or at the module count where the build is modular'
      Link_status:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Link-status` — how much of a committable link is on. It is an integer the rows below
          cap at one, or at the module count where the build is modular'
      Process_p:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_active
        description: '`Process-p` — PyPSA''s internal power `p`. A positive value drives every port at its
          own rate, withdrawing where the rate is negative and injecting where it is positive'
      Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_marginal_cost_curve AND Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-marginal_cost_piecewise` — the running cost of a generator that pays along
          a curve, held above the curve'
    constraints:
      Bus_nodal_balance:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Bus_attached
        expression: Bus_injection == 0
        description: '`Bus-nodal_balance` — what is generated at a bus meets the load there, less half of
          every incident line''s and transformer''s loss. What is generated includes storage dispatch and
          stores. It is net of what the links take away, plus what arrives over them after losses and any
          delay at every port they deliver to. Each process port draws or delivers at its own rate, and each
          passive branch carries its flow. PyPSA dissipates a branch''s loss half at either end. Each generator,
          storage unit, store and load term enters with its component''s `sign` (`constraints.py:1480-1481`,
          `:1592`), and an inactive load not at all. A bus nothing is attached to has no row. PyPSA refuses
          one that carries load. The file states no assumption for it.'
      Generator_e_sum_max:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        where: Generator_e_sum_max AND count(Generator_active, over=snapshot) > 0
        expression: sum(Generator_p * energy_limit_weight, over=snapshot) <= Generator_e_sum_max
        description: '`Generator-e_sum_max` — energy over the horizon, each period weighted by its years,
          is at most its budget. A budget of infinity is no row, and so is a generator active in no snapshot'
      Generator_e_sum_min:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        where: Generator_e_sum_min AND count(Generator_active, over=snapshot) > 0
        expression: sum(Generator_p * energy_limit_weight, over=snapshot) >= Generator_e_sum_min
        description: '`Generator-e_sum_min` — energy over the horizon, each period weighted by its years,
          is at least its floor. A floor of minus infinity is no row, and so is a generator active in no snapshot'
      Generator_ext_p_lower:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p >= Generator_p_min_pu * Generator_p_nom_ext
        description: '`Generator-ext-p-lower` — an extendable generator outputs at least its minimum of the
          chosen build'
      Generator_ext_p_nom_lower:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        where: Generator_p_nom_extendable AND Generator_active_asset
        expression: Generator_p_nom_ext >= Generator_p_nom_min
        description: '`Generator-ext-p_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Generator_ext_p_nom_upper:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        where: Generator_p_nom_extendable AND Generator_active_asset AND Generator_p_nom_max
        expression: Generator_p_nom_ext <= Generator_p_nom_max
        description: '`Generator-ext-p_nom-upper` — the chosen build is at most its cap in every scenario.
          A cap of infinity is no row'
      Generator_ext_p_upper:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p <= Generator_p_max_pu * Generator_p_nom_ext
        description: '`Generator-ext-p-upper` — an extendable generator outputs at most what is available
          of the chosen build'
      Generator_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p >= Generator_p_min_pu * Generator_p_nom
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-lower` — a fixed generator outputs at least its minimum'
      Generator_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p <= Generator_p_max_pu * Generator_p_nom
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-upper` — a fixed generator outputs at most what is available'
      Generator_p_nom_set:
        dims: [generator]
        where: Generator_p_nom_extendable AND Generator_active_asset AND Generator_p_nom_set
        expression: Generator_p_nom_ext == Generator_p_nom_set
        description: '`Generator-p_nom_set` — the chosen build pinned, wherever a value is given'
      Generator_p_ramp_limit_down:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: (Generator_ramp_limit_down OR Generator_ramp_limit_shut_down) AND NOT (Generator_committable
          AND Generator_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Generator_p_nom_mod > 0)) AND Generator_ramps_from_previous
          AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_previous_p - Generator_p <= Generator_ramp_down_allowance
        description: '`Generator-p-ramp_limit_down` — a generator lowers output no faster than its ramp limit
          of the build. A committed one lowers it no further than its shut-down ramp in the snapshot it turns
          off. A unit that came into the horizon running has a row at the first snapshot only where its `p_init`
          gives the output it brought in. No unit has one at the start of a later investment period, nor does
          any unit a big M releases instead'
      Generator_p_ramp_limit_up:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: (Generator_ramp_limit_up OR Generator_ramp_limit_start_up) AND NOT (Generator_committable AND
          Generator_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Generator_p_nom_mod > 0)) AND Generator_ramps_from_previous
          AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p - Generator_previous_p <= Generator_ramp_up_allowance
        description: '`Generator-p-ramp_limit_up` — a generator raises output no faster than its ramp limit
          of the build. A committed one raises it no further than its start-up ramp in the snapshot it turns
          on. A unit that came into the horizon running has a row at the first snapshot only where its `p_init`
          gives the output it brought in. No unit has one at the start of a later investment period, nor does
          any unit a big M releases instead'
      GlobalConstraint_tech_capacity_expansion_limit_eq:
        dims: [global_constraint, scenario]
        where: GlobalConstraint_type == 'tech_capacity_expansion_limit' AND GlobalConstraint_sense == '=='
        expression: tech_capacity_expansion == GlobalConstraint_constant
        description: '`tech_capacity_expansion_limit` — its total, at its constant'
      GlobalConstraint_tech_capacity_expansion_limit_lb:
        dims: [global_constraint, scenario]
        where: GlobalConstraint_type == 'tech_capacity_expansion_limit' AND GlobalConstraint_sense == '>='
        expression: tech_capacity_expansion >= GlobalConstraint_constant
        description: '`tech_capacity_expansion_limit` — its total, at least its constant'
      GlobalConstraint_tech_capacity_expansion_limit_ub:
        dims: [global_constraint, scenario]
        where: GlobalConstraint_type == 'tech_capacity_expansion_limit' AND GlobalConstraint_sense == '<='
        expression: tech_capacity_expansion <= GlobalConstraint_constant
        description: '`tech_capacity_expansion_limit` — its total, at most its constant'
      GlobalConstraint_transmission_expansion_cost_limit_eq:
        dims: [global_constraint, scenario]
        where: GlobalConstraint_type == 'transmission_expansion_cost_limit' AND GlobalConstraint_sense ==
          '=='
        expression: transmission_expansion_cost == GlobalConstraint_constant
        description: '`transmission_expansion_cost_limit` — its total, at its constant'
      GlobalConstraint_transmission_expansion_cost_limit_lb:
        dims: [global_constraint, scenario]
        where: GlobalConstraint_type == 'transmission_expansion_cost_limit' AND GlobalConstraint_sense ==
          '>='
        expression: transmission_expansion_cost >= GlobalConstraint_constant
        description: '`transmission_expansion_cost_limit` — its total, at least its constant'
      GlobalConstraint_transmission_volume_expansion_limit_ub:
        dims: [global_constraint, scenario]
        where: GlobalConstraint_type == 'transmission_volume_expansion_limit' AND GlobalConstraint_sense ==
          '<='
        expression: transmission_volume_expansion <= GlobalConstraint_constant
        description: '`transmission_volume_expansion_limit` — its total, at most its constant'
      Link_ext_p_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p >= Link_p_min_pu * Link_p_nom_ext
        description: '`Link-ext-p-lower` — an extendable link carries at least its minimum of the chosen build,
          negative for the other way'
      Link_ext_p_nom_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_active_asset
        expression: Link_p_nom_ext >= Link_p_nom_min
        description: '`Link-ext-p_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Link_ext_p_nom_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_active_asset AND Link_p_nom_max
        expression: Link_p_nom_ext <= Link_p_nom_max
        description: '`Link-ext-p_nom-upper` — the chosen build is at most its cap in every scenario. A cap
          of infinity is no row'
      Link_ext_p_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p <= Link_p_max_pu * Link_p_nom_ext
        description: '`Link-ext-p-upper` — an extendable link carries at most the chosen build'
      Link_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p >= Link_p_min_pu * Link_p_nom
        description: '`Link-fix-p-lower` — a fixed link carries at least its minimum, negative for the other
          way'
      Link_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p <= Link_p_max_pu * Link_p_nom
        description: '`Link-fix-p-upper` — a fixed link carries at most its nominal power'
      Link_p_nom_set:
        dims: [link]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_active_asset AND Link_p_nom_set
        expression: Link_p_nom_ext == Link_p_nom_set
        description: '`Link-p_nom_set` — the chosen build pinned, wherever a value is given'
      Link_p_ramp_limit_down:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: (Link_ramp_limit_down OR Link_ramp_limit_shut_down) AND NOT (Link_committable AND Link_p_nom_extendable
          AND NOT (Link_p_nom_mod > 0)) AND Link_ramps_from_previous AND Link_active
        expression: Link_previous_p - Link_p <= Link_ramp_down_allowance
        description: '`Link-p-ramp_limit_down` — a link lowers flow no faster than its ramp limit of the build.
          A committed one lowers it no further than its shut-down ramp in the snapshot it turns off. A link
          that came into the horizon running has a row at the first snapshot only where its `p_init` gives
          the flow it brought in. No link has one at the start of a later investment period, nor does any
          link a big M releases instead'
      Link_p_ramp_limit_up:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: (Link_ramp_limit_up OR Link_ramp_limit_start_up) AND NOT (Link_committable AND Link_p_nom_extendable
          AND NOT (Link_p_nom_mod > 0)) AND Link_ramps_from_previous AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p - Link_previous_p <= Link_ramp_up_allowance
        description: '`Link-p-ramp_limit_up` — a link raises flow no faster than its ramp limit of the build.
          A committed one raises it no further than its start-up ramp in the snapshot it turns on. A link
          that came into the horizon running has a row at the first snapshot only where its `p_init` gives
          the flow it brought in. No link has one at the start of a later investment period, nor does any
          link a big M releases instead'
      StorageUnit_energy_balance:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        expression: ((StorageUnit_charge_carried_in + ((StorageUnit_efficiency_store * StorageUnit_p_store)
          * snapshot_weightings_stores)) - ((StorageUnit_p_dispatch * snapshot_weightings_stores) / StorageUnit_efficiency_dispatch))
          + (StorageUnit_inflow * snapshot_weightings_stores) == StorageUnit_state_of_charge
        description: '`StorageUnit-energy_balance` — the charge carried in, plus what is stored after its
          efficiency, less what dispatch draws down before its own, plus inflow not spilled'
      StorageUnit_ext_p_dispatch_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_p_dispatch >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-p_dispatch-lower` — dispatch is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_ext_p_dispatch_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_p_dispatch <= StorageUnit_p_max_pu * StorageUnit_p_nom_ext
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-p_dispatch-upper` — an extendable unit dispatches at most the chosen
          build'
      StorageUnit_ext_p_nom_lower:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_active_asset
        expression: StorageUnit_p_nom_ext >= StorageUnit_p_nom_min
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-p_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      StorageUnit_ext_p_nom_upper:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_active_asset AND StorageUnit_p_nom_max
        expression: StorageUnit_p_nom_ext <= StorageUnit_p_nom_max
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-p_nom-upper` — the chosen build is at most its cap in every scenario.
          A cap of infinity is no row'
      StorageUnit_ext_p_store_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_p_store >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-p_store-lower` — storing is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_ext_p_store_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_p_store <= -StorageUnit_p_min_pu * StorageUnit_p_nom_ext
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-p_store-upper` — an extendable unit stores at most the chosen build,
          the minimum-per-unit column carrying that cap negated'
      StorageUnit_ext_state_of_charge_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-state_of_charge-lower` — charge is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_ext_state_of_charge_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge <= StorageUnit_max_hours * StorageUnit_p_nom_ext
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-state_of_charge-upper` — an extendable unit holds at most its hours
          at the chosen build'
      StorageUnit_fix_p_dispatch_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_p_dispatch >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-p_dispatch-lower` — dispatch is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_fix_p_dispatch_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_p_dispatch <= StorageUnit_p_max_pu * StorageUnit_p_nom
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-p_dispatch-upper` — a fixed unit dispatches at most its nominal power'
      StorageUnit_fix_p_store_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_p_store >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-p_store-lower` — storing is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_fix_p_store_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_p_store <= -StorageUnit_p_min_pu * StorageUnit_p_nom
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-p_store-upper` — a fixed unit stores at most its nominal power, the
          minimum-per-unit column carrying that cap negated'
      StorageUnit_fix_state_of_charge_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-state_of_charge-lower` — charge is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_fix_state_of_charge_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge <= StorageUnit_max_hours * StorageUnit_p_nom
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-state_of_charge-upper` — a fixed unit holds at most its hours at nominal
          power'
      StorageUnit_p_nom_set:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_active_asset AND StorageUnit_p_nom_set
        expression: StorageUnit_p_nom_ext == StorageUnit_p_nom_set
        description: '`StorageUnit-p_nom_set` — the chosen build pinned, wherever a value is given'
      Store_e_nom_set:
        dims: [store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active_asset AND Store_e_nom_set
        expression: Store_e_nom_ext == Store_e_nom_set
        description: '`Store-e_nom_set` — the chosen build pinned, wherever a value is given'
      Store_energy_balance:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_active
        expression: ((Store_energy_carried_in - ((Store_p * snapshot_weightings_stores) / Store_efficiency_dispatch))
          + (((Store_efficiency_store - (1 / Store_efficiency_dispatch)) * Store_p_store) * snapshot_weightings_stores))
          + (Store_inflow * snapshot_weightings_stores) == Store_e
        description: '`Store-energy_balance` — the energy carried in, less the discharge drawn down before
          its efficiency, plus the charge after its own, plus inflow not spilled. The net dispatch `p` is
          the discharge less `p_store`, so `p_store` enters with both efficiencies (`constraints.py:2472-2476`)'
      Store_ext_e_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active
        expression: Store_e >= Store_e_min_pu * Store_e_nom_ext
        description: '`Store-ext-e-lower` — an extendable store holds at least its floor of the chosen build'
      Store_ext_e_nom_lower:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active_asset
        expression: Store_e_nom_ext >= Store_e_nom_min
        description: '`Store-ext-e_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Store_ext_e_nom_upper:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active_asset AND Store_e_nom_max
        expression: Store_e_nom_ext <= Store_e_nom_max
        description: '`Store-ext-e_nom-upper` — the chosen build is at most its cap in every scenario. A cap
          of infinity is no row'
      Store_ext_e_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active
        expression: Store_e <= Store_e_max_pu * Store_e_nom_ext
        description: '`Store-ext-e-upper` — an extendable store holds at most the chosen build'
      Store_ext_p_store_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active
        expression: Store_p_store >= 0
        description: '`Store-ext-p_store-lower` — charging is non-negative'
      Store_ext_p_store_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active AND (NOT Store_split_dispatch OR Store_max_hours)
        expression: Store_p_store <= Store_charge_cap_pu * Store_e_nom_ext
        description: '`Store-ext-p_store-upper` — an extendable store charges at most the power rating of
          the chosen build where it splits its dispatch, and not at all where it does not. A store that splits
          and has no `max_hours` has no row'
      Store_fix_e_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: not Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active
        expression: Store_e >= Store_e_min_pu * Store_e_nom
        description: '`Store-fix-e-lower` — a fixed store holds at least its floor'
      Store_fix_e_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: not Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active
        expression: Store_e <= Store_e_max_pu * Store_e_nom
        description: '`Store-fix-e-upper` — a fixed store holds at most its nominal capacity'
      Store_fix_p_store_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: NOT Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active
        expression: Store_p_store >= 0
        description: '`Store-fix-p_store-lower` — charging is non-negative'
      Store_fix_p_store_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: NOT Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active AND (NOT Store_split_dispatch OR Store_max_hours)
        expression: Store_p_store <= Store_charge_cap_pu * Store_e_nom
        description: '`Store-fix-p_store-upper` — a fixed store charges at most its power rating where it
          splits its dispatch, and not at all where it does not. A store that splits and has no `max_hours`
          has no row'
    expressions:
      Bus_injection:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        expression: ((((Generator_injection + Link_injection) + Load_injection) + Process_injection) + StorageUnit_injection)
          + Store_injection
        description: what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each
          term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side
      Generator_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Generator_p_nom_ext * Generator_capital_cost * Generator_capital_weight)}
      Generator_injection: {expression: 'sum(Generator_sign * Generator_p, over=generator, by=Generator_bus[bus])'}
      Generator_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum((Generator_running_cost * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Generator_p * Generator_p)
          * Generator_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot)'}
      Generator_p_carried_over:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the output a generator carries over into a snapshot. At the first, it is the `p_init`
          it brought in, which is zero where it came in off. After that, it is the previous snapshot's
        cases:
          opening: {when: position(snapshot) == 0, expression: Generator_p_init}
        otherwise: shift(Generator_p, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      Generator_p_nom_committed:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        description: 'the build a committed unit''s ramp rows are taken against: one module where the build
          is modular, since its status counts modules, and the given build otherwise (`constraints.py:1131-1134`)'
        cases:
          modular_build: {when: Generator_p_nom_mod > 0, expression: Generator_p_nom_mod}
        otherwise: Generator_p_nom
      Generator_p_nom_effective:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        description: 'the build a generator''s limits are taken against: the chosen one where it is extendable,
          the given one otherwise'
        cases:
          extendable: {when: Generator_p_nom_extendable, expression: Generator_p_nom_ext}
        otherwise: Generator_p_nom
      Generator_previous_p:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'the output a generator carries into a snapshot. It is nothing at the first snapshot
          it is active in past the first of the horizon: PyPSA fills an output it did not build with zero
          (`constraints.py:716`). It is the output carried over otherwise'
        cases:
          opening_late: {when: 'position(snapshot) > 0 AND NOT shift(Generator_active, along=snapshot, offset=1)',
            expression: '0'}
        otherwise: Generator_p_carried_over
      Generator_previous_status:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the commitment state a generator carries into a snapshot. It is off at the first snapshot
          it is active in past the first of the horizon. PyPSA reads a status it did not build as off there
          (`constraints.py:391`). It is the state carried over otherwise
        cases:
          opening_late: {when: 'position(snapshot) > 0 AND NOT shift(Generator_active, along=snapshot, offset=1)',
            expression: '0'}
        otherwise: Generator_status_carried_over
      Generator_ramp_down_allowance:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: how far a generator may lower output between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the
          build while it stays on, plus its shut-down ramp in the snapshot it turns off
        cases:
          committed: {when: Generator_committable, expression: Generator_ramp_down_rate * Generator_p_nom_committed
              * Generator_status + Generator_shut_down_rate * Generator_p_nom_committed * (Generator_ramp_previous_status
              - Generator_status)}
        otherwise: Generator_ramp_down_rate * Generator_p_nom_effective
      Generator_ramp_down_rate:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the ramp limit in a unit's down row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_down`. It is the full build
          where PyPSA has none, since a shut-down ramp alone builds the row
        cases:
          given: {when: Generator_ramp_limit_down, expression: Generator_ramp_limit_down}
        otherwise: '1'
      Generator_ramp_previous_status:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the status a committed unit's ramp rows carry into a snapshot. At the first snapshot,
          a fixed modular unit that came in running has every module on, since the state it brought in is
          on or off (`constraints.py:1152-1157`). The transition and down-time rows count it as one module
          (PyPSA/PyPSA#2114). It is the state carried in otherwise
        cases:
          opening_modules: {when: position(snapshot) == 0 AND NOT Generator_p_nom_extendable AND Generator_p_nom_mod
              > 0, expression: Generator_status_initial * Generator_modules_installed}
        otherwise: Generator_previous_status
      Generator_ramp_up_allowance:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: how far a generator may raise output between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the
          build while it stays on, plus its start-up ramp in the snapshot it turns on
        cases:
          committed: {when: Generator_committable, expression: Generator_ramp_up_rate * Generator_p_nom_committed
              * Generator_ramp_previous_status + Generator_start_up_rate * Generator_p_nom_committed * (Generator_status
              - Generator_ramp_previous_status)}
        otherwise: Generator_ramp_up_rate * Generator_p_nom_effective
      Generator_ramp_up_rate:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the ramp limit in a unit's up row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_up`. It is the full build where
          PyPSA has none, since a start-up ramp alone builds the row
        cases:
          given: {when: Generator_ramp_limit_up, expression: Generator_ramp_limit_up}
        otherwise: '1'
      Generator_running_cost:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'what a generator''s output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve
          where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as
          PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`)'
        cases:
          curve: {when: Generator_marginal_cost_curve, expression: Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise}
        otherwise: Generator_p * Generator_marginal_cost
      Generator_shut_down_rate:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        description: the shut-down ramp in a unit's down row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_shut_down`), or the full
          build where it has none
        cases:
          given: {when: Generator_ramp_limit_shut_down, expression: Generator_ramp_limit_shut_down}
        otherwise: '1'
      Generator_start_up_rate:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        description: the start-up ramp in a unit's up row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_start_up`), or the full build
          where it has none
        cases:
          given: {when: Generator_ramp_limit_start_up, expression: Generator_ramp_limit_start_up}
        otherwise: '1'
      Generator_status_carried_over:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'the state a generator carries over into a snapshot: the state it brought into the horizon
          at the first, the previous snapshot''s after that'
        cases:
          opening: {when: position(snapshot) == 0, expression: Generator_status_initial}
        otherwise: shift(Generator_status, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      Generator_tech_capacity_expansion: {expression: 'sum(Generator_p_nom_ext * Generator_tech_capacity_weight,
          over=generator)'}
      Link_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Link_p_nom_ext * Link_capital_cost * Link_capital_weight)}
      Link_injection: {expression: '-sum(Link_p, over=link, by=Link_bus0[bus]) + sum(Link_output_arrival,
          over=link_output, by=Link_output_bus[bus])'}
      Link_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Link_p * Link_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Link_p * Link_p) * Link_marginal_cost_quadratic)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link),
          over=snapshot)'}
      Link_output_arrival:
        dims: [link_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's
          `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot
          the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end.
          Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that
          does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Link_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]), along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency
      Link_p_carried_over:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the output a link carries over into a snapshot. At the first, it is the `p_init` it brought
          in, which is zero where it came in off. After that, it is the previous snapshot's
        cases:
          opening: {when: position(snapshot) == 0, expression: Link_p_init}
        otherwise: shift(Link_p, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      Link_p_nom_committed:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: 'the build a committed link''s ramp rows are taken against: one module where the build
          is modular, since its status counts modules, and the given build otherwise (`constraints.py:1131-1134`)'
        cases:
          modular_build: {when: Link_p_nom_mod > 0, expression: Link_p_nom_mod}
        otherwise: Link_p_nom
      Link_p_nom_effective:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: 'the build a link''s limits are taken against: the chosen one where it is extendable,
          the given one otherwise'
        cases:
          extendable: {when: Link_p_nom_extendable, expression: Link_p_nom_ext}
        otherwise: Link_p_nom
      Link_previous_p:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'the output a link carries into a snapshot. It is nothing at the first snapshot it is
          active in past the first of the horizon: PyPSA fills an output it did not build with zero (`constraints.py:716`).
          It is the output carried over otherwise'
        cases:
          opening_late: {when: 'position(snapshot) > 0 AND NOT shift(Link_active, along=snapshot, offset=1)',
            expression: '0'}
        otherwise: Link_p_carried_over
      Link_previous_status:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the commitment state a link carries into a snapshot. It is off at the first snapshot
          it is active in past the first of the horizon. PyPSA reads a status it did not build as off there
          (`constraints.py:391`). It is the state carried over otherwise
        cases:
          opening_late: {when: 'position(snapshot) > 0 AND NOT shift(Link_active, along=snapshot, offset=1)',
            expression: '0'}
        otherwise: Link_status_carried_over
      Link_ramp_down_allowance:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: how far a link may lower flow between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build
          while it stays on, plus its shut-down ramp in the snapshot it turns off
        cases:
          committed: {when: Link_committable, expression: Link_ramp_down_rate * Link_p_nom_committed * Link_status
              + Link_shut_down_rate * Link_p_nom_committed * (Link_ramp_previous_status - Link_status)}
        otherwise: Link_ramp_down_rate * Link_p_nom_effective
      Link_ramp_down_rate:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the ramp limit in a link's down row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_down`. It is the full build
          where PyPSA has none, since a shut-down ramp alone builds the row
        cases:
          given: {when: Link_ramp_limit_down, expression: Link_ramp_limit_down}
        otherwise: '1'
      Link_ramp_previous_status:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the status a committed link's ramp rows carry into a snapshot. At the first snapshot,
          a fixed modular link that came in running has every module on, since the state it brought in is
          on or off (`constraints.py:1152-1157`). The transition and down-time rows count it as one module
          (PyPSA/PyPSA#2114). It is the state carried in otherwise
        cases:
          opening_modules: {when: position(snapshot) == 0 AND NOT Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_p_nom_mod
              > 0, expression: Link_status_initial * Link_modules_installed}
        otherwise: Link_previous_status
      Link_ramp_up_allowance:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: how far a link may raise flow between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build
          while it stays on, plus its start-up ramp in the snapshot it turns on
        cases:
          committed: {when: Link_committable, expression: Link_ramp_up_rate * Link_p_nom_committed * Link_ramp_previous_status
              + Link_start_up_rate * Link_p_nom_committed * (Link_status - Link_ramp_previous_status)}
        otherwise: Link_ramp_up_rate * Link_p_nom_effective
      Link_ramp_up_rate:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the ramp limit in a link's up row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_up`. It is the full build where
          PyPSA has none, since a start-up ramp alone builds the row
        cases:
          given: {when: Link_ramp_limit_up, expression: Link_ramp_limit_up}
        otherwise: '1'
      Link_shut_down_rate:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: the shut-down ramp in a link's down row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_shut_down`), or the full
          build where it has none
        cases:
          given: {when: Link_ramp_limit_shut_down, expression: Link_ramp_limit_shut_down}
        otherwise: '1'
      Link_start_up_rate:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: the start-up ramp in a link's up row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_start_up`), or the full build
          where it has none
        cases:
          given: {when: Link_ramp_limit_start_up, expression: Link_ramp_limit_start_up}
        otherwise: '1'
      Link_status_carried_over:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'the state a link carries over into a snapshot: the state it brought into the horizon
          at the first, the previous snapshot''s after that'
        cases:
          opening: {when: position(snapshot) == 0, expression: Link_status_initial}
        otherwise: shift(Link_status, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      Link_tech_capacity_expansion: {expression: 'sum(Link_p_nom_ext * Link_tech_capacity_weight, over=link)'}
      Link_transmission_expansion_cost: {expression: 'sum(Link_p_nom_ext * Link_expansion_cost_weight, over=link)'}
      Link_transmission_volume_expansion: {expression: 'sum(Link_p_nom_ext * Link_volume_weight, over=link)'}
      Load_demand:
        dims: [load, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is
          active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`)
        cases:
          active: {when: Load_active, expression: Load_sign * Load_p_set}
        otherwise: '0'
      Load_injection: {expression: 'sum(Load_demand, over=load, by=Load_bus[bus])'}
      Process_injection: {expression: 'sum(Process_output_arrival, over=process_output, by=Process_output_bus[bus])'}
      Process_output_arrival:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by
          the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot
          the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's
          end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port
          that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Process_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])
              * Process_rate'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]), along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Process_rate
      StorageUnit_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * StorageUnit_p_nom_ext * StorageUnit_capital_cost
          * StorageUnit_capital_weight)}
      StorageUnit_charge_carried_in:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: the charge a unit opens a snapshot with. At the first snapshot it is active in, it is
          its last such snapshot's less standing loss where it is cyclic. Where it is not, it is the given
          initial charge, which no standing loss has touched yet. Otherwise it is the previous snapshot's
          less standing loss. A unit built in a later period opens in that period, and a cyclic one that retires
          closes on its own last snapshot. Per period, the same holds with each investment period as the horizon
        cases:
          cyclic: {when: StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge AND NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period
              AND NOT StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial_per_period AND (position(snapshot) == 0 OR StorageUnit_opens_late),
            expression: 'StorageUnit_retention * shift(shift(StorageUnit_state_of_charge, along=snapshot,
              offset=1, edge=''wrap''), along=snapshot, offset=StorageUnit_inactive_snapshots, edge=''wrap'')'}
          opening: {when: NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge AND NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period
              AND NOT StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial_per_period AND (position(snapshot) == 0 OR StorageUnit_opens_late),
            expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial}
          period_cyclic: {when: StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period, expression: 'StorageUnit_retention
              * shift(StorageUnit_state_of_charge, along=snapshot, offset=1, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])'}
          period_opening: {when: 'StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial_per_period AND NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period
              AND position(snapshot, within=snapshot_period[period]) == 0', expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial}
        otherwise: StorageUnit_retention * shift(StorageUnit_state_of_charge, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      StorageUnit_injection: {expression: 'sum(StorageUnit_sign * (StorageUnit_p_dispatch - StorageUnit_p_store),
          over=storage_unit, by=StorageUnit_bus[bus])'}
      StorageUnit_opex: {expression: '(sum(sum(((StorageUnit_p_dispatch * StorageUnit_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=storage_unit), over=snapshot) +
          sum(sum((((StorageUnit_p_dispatch * StorageUnit_p_dispatch) * StorageUnit_marginal_cost_quadratic)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=storage_unit),
          over=snapshot)) + sum(sum(((StorageUnit_state_of_charge * StorageUnit_marginal_cost_storage) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=storage_unit), over=snapshot)'}
      StorageUnit_tech_capacity_expansion: {expression: 'sum(StorageUnit_p_nom_ext * StorageUnit_tech_capacity_weight,
          over=storage_unit)'}
      Store_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Store_e_nom_ext * Store_capital_cost * Store_capital_weight)}
      Store_charge_cap_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: the most charging through `p_store`, per unit of `e_nom`. It is `-p_min_pu / max_hours`
          for a store that splits its dispatch, and zero otherwise (`stores.py:79-86`)
        cases:
          split: {when: Store_split_dispatch, expression: -Store_p_min_pu / Store_max_hours}
        otherwise: '0'
      Store_energy_carried_in:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: the energy a store opens a snapshot with. At the first snapshot it is active in, it is
          its last such snapshot's less standing loss where it is cyclic. Where it is not, it is the given
          initial energy, which no standing loss has touched yet. Otherwise it is the previous snapshot's
          less standing loss. A store built in a later period opens in that period, and a cyclic one that
          retires closes on its own last snapshot. Per period, the same holds with each investment period
          as the horizon
        cases:
          cyclic: {when: Store_e_cyclic AND NOT Store_e_cyclic_per_period AND NOT Store_e_initial_per_period
              AND (position(snapshot) == 0 OR Store_opens_late), expression: 'Store_retention * shift(shift(Store_e,
              along=snapshot, offset=1, edge=''wrap''), along=snapshot, offset=Store_inactive_snapshots, edge=''wrap'')'}
          opening: {when: NOT Store_e_cyclic AND NOT Store_e_cyclic_per_period AND NOT Store_e_initial_per_period
              AND (position(snapshot) == 0 OR Store_opens_late), expression: Store_e_initial}
          period_cyclic: {when: Store_e_cyclic_per_period, expression: 'Store_retention * shift(Store_e, along=snapshot,
              offset=1, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])'}
          period_opening: {when: 'Store_e_initial_per_period AND NOT Store_e_cyclic_per_period AND position(snapshot,
              within=snapshot_period[period]) == 0', expression: Store_e_initial}
        otherwise: Store_retention * shift(Store_e, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      Store_injection: {expression: 'sum(Store_sign * Store_p, over=store, by=Store_bus[bus])'}
      Store_opex: {expression: '(((sum(sum(((Store_p * Store_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=store), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Store_p
          * Store_p) * Store_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=store), over=snapshot)) + sum(sum(((Store_e * Store_marginal_cost_storage)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=store),
          over=snapshot)) + sum(sum((((Store_p + Store_p_store) * Store_marginal_cost_dispatch) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=store), over=snapshot)) + sum(sum(((Store_p_store
          * Store_marginal_cost_store) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]),
          over=store), over=snapshot)'}
      Store_tech_capacity_expansion: {expression: 'sum(Store_e_nom_ext * Store_tech_capacity_weight, over=store)'}
      energy_limit_weight:
        dims: [snapshot]
        expression: snapshot_weightings_generators * at(period_weight_years, by=snapshot_period[period])
        description: 'what one unit of power at a snapshot counts for in an `e_sum` row: the generator weighting
          times the years of the snapshot''s period, as in an `operational_limit` row (`constraints.py:2935-2937`)'
      risk_weighted_opex: {expression: 'sum(scenario_weight * scenario_opex, over=scenario)'}
      scenario_opex:
        dims: [scenario]
        expression: ((Generator_opex + Link_opex) + StorageUnit_opex) + Store_opex
        description: 'what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot''s hours
          and its period, before the scenario''s own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted,
          as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`)'
      tech_capacity_expansion:
        dims: [global_constraint]
        expression: ((Generator_tech_capacity_expansion + Link_tech_capacity_expansion) + StorageUnit_tech_capacity_expansion)
          + Store_tech_capacity_expansion
        description: 'what a `tech_capacity_expansion_limit` row totals: the chosen build of the row''s carrier-and-bus
          set'
      total_cost:
        dims: []
        expression: (((Generator_capex + Link_capex) + StorageUnit_capex) + Store_capex) + risk_weighted_opex
        description: what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over
          the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail
      transmission_expansion_cost:
        dims: [global_constraint, scenario]
        expression: Link_transmission_expansion_cost
        description: 'what a `transmission_expansion_cost_limit` row totals: capital cost times the chosen
          build of the row''s branches'
      transmission_volume_expansion:
        dims: [global_constraint, scenario]
        expression: Link_transmission_volume_expansion
        description: 'what a `transmission_volume_expansion_limit` row totals: length times the chosen build
          of the row''s branches'
    conditions:
      Generator_committed: {condition: Generator_committable AND Generator_active, description: 'a committable
          generator that is active in the snapshot''s period: every unit-commitment row''s set'}
      Generator_marginal_cost_curve: {condition: 'count(Generator_marginal_cost_curve_p, over=breakpoint)
          > 0 AND Generator_active_asset', description: 'a generator that pays along a piecewise `marginal_cost`
          curve: one of PyPSA''s `active_assets` with curve data (`optimize.py:307`, `piecewise.py:230-257`)'}
      Generator_ramps_from_previous: {condition: 'position(snapshot, within=snapshot_period[period]) > 0 OR
          (position(snapshot) == 0 AND (Generator_status_initial == 0 OR Generator_p_init))', description: 'a
          snapshot whose ramp uses a previous output. It is any snapshot but its period''s first, and the
          horizon''s first where the generator comes in off or carries an initial output'}
      Link_committed: {condition: Link_committable AND Link_active, description: 'a committable link that
          is active in the snapshot''s period: every unit-commitment row''s set'}
      Link_ramps_from_previous: {condition: 'position(snapshot, within=snapshot_period[period]) > 0 OR (position(snapshot)
          == 0 AND (Link_status_initial == 0 OR Link_p_init))', description: 'a snapshot whose ramp uses a
          previous output. It is any snapshot but its period''s first, and the horizon''s first where the
          link comes in off or carries an initial output'}
      StorageUnit_ext: {condition: StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_active, description: a storage
          unit with an extendable build that is active in the snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `ext` rows}
      StorageUnit_fix: {condition: NOT StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_active, description: a
          storage unit with a fixed build that is active in the snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `fix` rows}
    objective: {sense: minimize, expression: total_cost}
    ```

    The prep — every table the spec declares, from the network — and the solve:

    ```python
    from differential.pypsa.prep import relation, static, varying, weighting


    def _cycle_periods(n: pypsa.Network, multi: bool) -> list[tuple[object, object]]:
        """``(label, investment_period)`` per period PyPSA builds cycles for — every period under ``multi_investment_periods``, else the one with no period, which takes every branch."""
        return [(p, p) for p in period_labels(n)] if multi else [(PLAIN_PERIOD, None)]


    def _cycle_weights(n: pypsa.Network, multi: bool) -> dict[str, object]:
        """The KVL rows PyPSA itself writes, per period and branch — ``n.cycle_matrix(apply_weights=True)``, times the 1e5 PyPSA scales every cycle row by for conditioning.

        Each period has its own basis, of the branches standing in it, so a cycle
        label is a position in its period's basis. A branch whose weight is NaN — an
        extendable one at zero nominal rating, whose per-unit reactance is infinite
        — has no term: linopy drops it.

        A transformer's phase shift enters the same rows: a fixed one as a constant
        in radians at each snapshot of the period, a varying one as the shift
        decision times its cycle sign and π/180. PyPSA builds the basis from the
        first scenario only, and adds a shift only for a transformer that stands;
        a fixed shift of zero adds nothing and has no row.
        """
        n.determine_network_topology()
        n.calculate_dependent_values()
        transformers = first_scenario(n.static('Transformer'))
        varying_ = transformers['phase_shift_min'] < transformers['phase_shift_max']
        dense = get_switchable_as_dense(n, 'Transformer', 'phase_shift').set_axis(timesteps(n), axis=0)
        if dense.columns.nlevels > 1:
            dense = dense.T.groupby(level='name').first().T
        active = active_by_snapshot(n, 'Transformer')
        stamps = pd.Series(period_of(n) if multi else PLAIN_PERIOD, index=timesteps(n))
        rows: dict[str, list[dict]] = {'Line': [], 'Transformer': []}
        shift_rows, decision_rows = [], []
        basis: dict[object, set[str]] = {}
        for label, period in _cycle_periods(n, multi):
            weighted = n.cycle_matrix(investment_period=period, apply_weights=True) * 1e5
            if weighted.empty:
                continue
            basis[label] = {str(cycle) for cycle in weighted.columns}
            for (kind, name), weights in weighted.iterrows():
                rows.setdefault(kind, [])
                rows[kind].extend(
                    {'period': label, DIM[kind]: str(name), 'cycle': str(cycle), 'value': float(w)}
                    for cycle, w in weights.items()
                    if w and not math.isnan(w)
                )
            plain = n.cycle_matrix(investment_period=period, apply_weights=False)
            if 'Transformer' not in plain.index.get_level_values(0):
                continue
            snapshots = stamps.index[stamps.to_numpy() == label]
            for name, signs in plain.loc['Transformer'].iterrows():
                for cycle, sign in signs.items():
                    if not sign:
                        continue
                    if varying_.get(name, False):
                        decision_rows.append(
                            {
                                'period': label,
                                'transformer': str(name),
                                'cycle': str(cycle),
                                'value': sign * math.pi / 180 * 1e5,
                            }
                        )
                        continue
                    shift_rows.extend(
                        {
                            'snapshot': t,
                            'transformer': str(name),
                            'cycle': str(cycle),
                            'value': float(sign) * float(dense.at[t, name]) * math.pi / 180 * 1e5,
                        }
                        for t in snapshots
                        if dense.at[t, name] and active.at[t, name]
                    )
        line = pd.DataFrame(rows['Line'], columns=['period', 'line', 'cycle', 'value']).astype({'value': float})
        transformer = pd.DataFrame(rows['Transformer'], columns=['period', 'transformer', 'cycle', 'value']).astype(
            {'value': float}
        )
        cycles = list(pd.unique(pd.concat([line['cycle'], transformer['cycle']])))
        return {
            'cycle': pl.Series('cycle', cycles, dtype=pl.String),
            'Cycle_in_basis': pd.DataFrame(
                [
                    {'period': label, 'cycle': cycle, 'value': cycle in basis.get(label, set())}
                    for label, _ in _cycle_periods(n, multi)
                    for cycle in cycles
                ],
                columns=['period', 'cycle', 'value'],
            ).astype({'value': bool}),
            'Line_cycle_weight': line,
            'Transformer_cycle_weight': transformer,
            'Transformer_phase_shift_weight': pd.DataFrame(
                shift_rows, columns=['snapshot', 'transformer', 'cycle', 'value']
            ).astype({'value': float}),
            'Transformer_phase_shift_cycle_weight': _everywhere(
                pd.DataFrame(decision_rows, columns=['period', 'transformer', 'cycle', 'value']),
                {
                    'period': [label for label, _ in _cycle_periods(n, multi)],
                    'transformer': list(transformers.index.astype(str)),
                    'cycle': cycles,
                },
            ),
            'Transformer_phase_shift_varying': per_component('Transformer', varying_, bool),
            'Transformer_phase_shift_min': per_component('Transformer', transformers['phase_shift_min']),
            'Transformer_phase_shift_max': per_component('Transformer', transformers['phase_shift_max']),
            'Transformer_phase_shift_fixed': long('Transformer', dense),
        }


    def _everywhere(table: pd.DataFrame, labels: dict[str, list]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """*table* with a zero at every combination of *labels* it has no row for — a table the file refuses to find short."""
        product = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(list(labels.values()), names=list(labels)).to_frame(index=False)
        return product.merge(table, on=list(labels), how='left').fillna({'value': 0.0}).astype({'value': float})


    n = build()  # the network from the PyPSA tab

    sources = {
        'bus': pl.Series('bus', list(names(n.buses.index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String),
            **{
                dim: pl.Series(dim, list(names(n.static(component).index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String)
                for component, dim in DIM.items()
            },
            **scenarios(n),
            **periods(n, multi),
            **carriers(n, multi),
        'snapshot': pl.Series('snapshot', list(timesteps(n)), dtype=pl.Datetime('us')),
        'Generator_bus': relation(n, 'Generator', 'bus'),
        'Link_bus0': relation(n, 'Link', 'bus0'),
        'Load_bus': relation(n, 'Load', 'bus'),
        'StorageUnit_bus': relation(n, 'StorageUnit', 'bus'),
        'Store_bus': relation(n, 'Store', 'bus'),
        'Bus_attached': attached(n),
        'Generator_sign': per_component('Generator', first_scenario(n.generators['sign'])),
        'Load_active': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['active']), bool),
        'Load_p_set': varying(n, 'Load', 'p_set'),
        'Load_sign': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['sign'])),
        'snapshot_weightings_generators': weighting(n, 'generators'),
            **{name: table for component in DISPATCHABLE for name, table in dispatchable(n, component, optimize).items()},
            **ports(n, 'Link'),
            **ports(n, 'Process'),
            **storage(n, multi),
            **branches(n),
            **_cycle_weights(n, multi),
            **losses(n, optimize, outages),
            **security(n, outages, multi),
            **global_constraints(n, multi),
            **flow_based(n),
            **marginal_cost_curve(n),
        'snapshot_weightings_objective': weighting(n, 'objective'),
        'snapshot_weightings_stores': weighting(n, 'stores'),
    }

    with sps.solve('differential/pypsa/rungs/rung_03_expansion.yaml', sources) as result:
        result.objective  # 7633.908502024291
    ```

    ```python
    """Rung 3: expansion — extendable capacity, energy-sum bounds, fixed and set nominal capacities."""

    from __future__ import annotations

    import spine


    def build():

        n = spine.build()
        n.add('Bus', 'island')

        n.add('Carrier', 'solarpv')
        n.add('Carrier', 'dc')
        n.add('Carrier', 'phs')
        n.add('Carrier', 'h2')
        n.add(
            'Generator',

            bus='north',
            carrier='onwind',

            p_nom_min=5,

        n.add(
            'Generator',

        )
        n.add('Generator', 'diesel', bus='island', marginal_cost=40, p_nom=60, e_sum_max=70)
        n.add(
            'Link',
            'cable',
            bus0='north',
            bus1='island',
            carrier='dc',
            length=120,
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            capital_cost=20,
            p_nom_max=30,
            efficiency=0.95,

            ramp_limit_up=0.3,
            ramp_limit_down=0.3,
        )
        n.add('Load', 'island_load', bus='island', p_set=10)
        n.add(
            'StorageUnit',
            'pump',
            bus='north',
            carrier='phs',
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            capital_cost=15,
            p_nom_max=30,
            max_hours=4,
            efficiency_store=0.9,
            efficiency_dispatch=0.9,
            cyclic_state_of_charge=True,
            p_nom_set=20,
        )
        n.add('StorageUnit', 'ice', bus='island', max_hours=2, p_nom=8, state_of_charge_initial=6)
        n.add(

        n.add(

        n.add(

        n.add(

        n.add(

            'tech_h2',
            type='tech_capacity_expansion_limit',
            carrier_attribute='h2',
            sense='>=',
            constant=30,
        )
        n.add(
            'GlobalConstraint',
            'vol_dc',

            constant=500,
    ```
